abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of cloaking an event in the time domain. Our temporal cloaking scheme is based on the time-space duality and the use of novel split time-lenses.

articleTitle: Tailored light for high precision manufacture
abstract: High precision manufacturing with lasers requires selection of specific laser beam parameters for optimal processes. Example parameters and processes (exploiting either melting or vaporisation) are presented, optimised to provide fine-scale structuring of glasses and metals.

articleTitle: Sub-250nm room temperature optical gain from AlGaN/AlN multiple quantum wells structures
abstract: We demonstrate room temperature, low threshold, deep-UV, TE polarized optical gain of 118 ± 9 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at a pumping fluence of 15 μJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in AlGaN/AlN structures grown by Molecular Beam Epitaxy.

articleTitle: Super resolution by sub-wavelength polarization distribution using conical diffraction
abstract: We present a super resolution scheme that can be incorporated in standard fluorescence microscopes based on spatial modulation of the polarization inside the Airy disk of a focused illumination beam using conical diffraction.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser half-beam writing paradox
abstract: Contrary to common belief asymmetric imprinting, revealed as different modification thresholds for two halves of Gaussian beam, is demonstrated in amorphous silicon. The phenomenon is interpreted in terms of anisotropic transport produced by ultrashort light pulses.

articleTitle: Quantum random bit generation by stimulated Raman scattering
abstract: We introduce a quantum random number generator based on the phase measurement of Stokes light generated by amplification of zero-point vacuum fluctuations using stimulated Raman scattering in bulk diamond.

articleTitle: Optical routers with ultra-low power consumption for photonic networks-on-chip
abstract: We demonstrate a five-port optical router for photonic networks-on-chip. The proposed topology design improves the performances in terms of power consumption, optical loss, crosstalk and channel uniformity of the optical router.

articleTitle: Generation of a macroscopic singlet state in an atomic ensemble
abstract: We report on an experiment for generating singlet states in a cold atomic ensemble. We use quantum non-demolition measurement and feedback control to produce a macroscopic spin state with total spin zero and reduced spin fluctuations.

articleTitle: Detection of trace amounts of NO2 using frequency modulated off-axis cavity ring-down spectroscopy
abstract: Detection of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at the ppb-level is demonstrated using a vibration-insensitive variation of cavity ring-down spectroscopy. Modulating the laser frequency and off-axis alignment simplify the detector making it more suitable for in-situ monitoring.

articleTitle: Laser interferometry in space for gravitational wave detection and Geodesy
abstract: Laser interferometry between drag-free satellites has been under development for 20 years. It will be used for the observation of low-frequency gravitational waves in LISA. Similar technology will be employed for the GRACE Follow-On Geodesy mission.

articleTitle: On-chip integrated spectrometer using nanobeam photonic crystal cavities
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated on-chip spectrometer employing photonic crystal nanobeam photonic crystal cavities for telecom wavelength. Acetylene absorption line was successfully measured by thermo-optic tuning of a single device.

articleTitle: Fabrication of graphene by pulsed laser annealing from a graphene oxide thin film
abstract: A laser-based thin-film processing scheme for printing and annealing of graphene oxide is reported. This method is able to print and simultaneously reduce the graphene oxide to graphene. The resulting graphene thin film is with good transmittance and its resistance is dramatically reduced from 200 MΩ to 80 KΩ.

articleTitle: Measurement of the nonlinear refractive index of multimode TeO2 fiber by using the induced grating autocorrelation technique
abstract: The electric field of a dual-line 1342 nm passively modelocked Nd:YVO4 laser was determined and used to measure the nonlinear refractive index of a 1-meter multimode TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fiber using a modified induced grating autocorrelation technique.

articleTitle: Four-photon polarization-entangled states with minimal spectral and spatial entanglement
abstract: We present two schemes for generating four-photon states: One for direct GHZ state generation and another yielding an entire class of polarization-entangled states. Both begin with photon pairs having minimal spectral and spatial entanglement.

articleTitle: Broadband extinction of core-shell microspheres
abstract: Broad-band, mass-normalized extinction cross-sections up to 1m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/g are demonstrated using chemically modified gold fractal nanostructures grown on silica microparticles.

articleTitle: Lasing from living biological cells expressing green fluorescent protein
abstract: We show that GFP, a biologically produced material, is a viable optical gain medium and construct true bio-lasers, in which the optical gain is provided by living mammalian or bacterial cells synthesizing GFP.

articleTitle: Timing jitter measurements of a 130 GHz passively mode locked QDash laser from its optical spectrum
abstract: Timing jitter measurements from the optical spectrum of single-section QDash-lasers validate an analytical expression relating its diffusion constant to the mode linewidths. 2.6 fs pulse-to-pulse timing jitter is extracted from a 130 GHz device.

articleTitle: High-resolution absolute distance measurement using a dual-wavelength, dual-comb, femtosecond fiber laser
abstract: A high-resolution laser ranging scheme using one dual-wavelength femtosecond fiber laser, which generates a dual-comb with their frequency difference inherently locked by the intracavity dispersion, is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Quantum simulations with a two-dimensional quantum walk
abstract: We present an experimental implementation of a quantum walk in two dimensions, employing an optical fiber network. We simulated entangling operations and nonlinear multi-particle interactions revealing phenomena such as bound states.

articleTitle: Adaptive characterization of few-cycle wavepackets with high-pulse-fidelity time-wavefront sensors
abstract: Few-cycle wavepackets are characterized by adaptive time-wavefront sensing with spatial light modulators. Highly localized sub-beams are individually shaped to enable wavefront analysis, 2D autocorrelation and spatial encoding at low temporal distortion.

articleTitle: A reconfigurable photonic chip for generating, manipulating and measuring entanglement and mixture
abstract: We demonstrate a reconfigurable quantum photonic circuit with eight phase shifters. We use this device to generate and characterise maximally entangled two-qubit states, violate Bell inequalities, and generate single-photon mixed states.

articleTitle: Photoinduced phase transitions in strongly correlated electron systems
abstract: The search for materials that show a phase transition triggered by weak external stimulation of light is an important and attractive target for photonic and materials science today. My talk reviews experimental evidence indicating that photo-injected local excitation can really trigger an electron-lattice coupled cooperative phenomenon named as photo-induced phase transition (PIPT: Photo-domino effect) in wide class of materials based on the dynamical x-ray technique combined with the ultrafast spectroscopy. Obtained results also demonstrate that ‘hidden phase’ in strongly correlated systems which never appears in the phase diagram under thermo-equilibrium condition plays an essential role for the gigantic photo-response of the strongly correlated electron systems.

articleTitle: Generation of ultrabroadband coherent infrared wave with 200 THz bandwidth using air plasma driven by intense sub 10 fs pulses
abstract: We demonstrated the generation of infrared wave exceeding 200 THz through air plasma using sub-10-fs pulses produced by hollow fiber compression. Electro-optic sampling with 20-μm GaSe crystal assures the wave is coherent.

articleTitle: Electrically generated indistinguishable and entangled photon pairs
abstract: We present measurements on electrically generated photons from a quantum dot in an LED structure, showing high entanglement fidelity and two-photon interference visibility, both necessary requirements for scalable quantum communication and logic.

articleTitle: Optofluidic hollow-core photonic crystal fiber coupled to mass spectrometry for rapid photochemical reaction analysis
abstract: Optofluidic hollow-core photonic crystal fibers facilitate both efficient excitation of photochemical reactions and instantaneous feeding of the products into a mass spectrometer for rapid molecular structure determination using low sample volumes.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave operation of type-I GaSb-based narrow ridge waveguide lasers near 3254nm
abstract: Narrow ridge waveguide (5um) laser diodes were fabricated using type-I InGaAsSb/AlInGaAsSb quantum well active regions on GaSb. The devices operate in continuous-wave mode near 3254nm with a total light output of 7.4mW at 20°C (uncoated facets).

articleTitle: Coherent control of cold matter waves
abstract: For a two-level system we developed quantum protocols in order to reach a final state in the shortest allowed time, with very high fidelity and robustness against imperfections in the experimental apparatus.

articleTitle: Magnetic vector-field of optical antennas from electromagnetic duality
abstract: Combining scattering-scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) with infrared synchrotron micro-spectroscopy we determine the magnetic near-field modes of an infrared linear antenna by measuring the electric field of its electro-magnetic dual, the linear slot antenna.

articleTitle: Practical design of a layered polymer GRIN lens
abstract: Design of an achromat F/3 singlet lens made of layered polymer GRIN material is presented. Lens outperforms a commercial glass doublet. Optimization requires efficient bounding of refractive index function. A custom material model handles dispersion.

articleTitle: Kilohertz-rate femtosecond-multi-photon-excited fluorescence imaging of atomic species in gas-phase reacting flows
abstract: We demonstrate two-photon-excited, laser-induced-fluorescence (TPLIF) imaging of atomic hydrogen in flames at 1-10 kHz using 205-nm femtosecond laser excitation. Unlike traditional ns or ps laser-based approaches, fs-TPLIF images are nearly free of photolytic interference.

articleTitle: Fabrication of thin metallic-film subwavelength-grating polarizers for terahertz region by the imprinting method
abstract: Fabrication of metallic-film subwavelength-grating polarizers is greatly simplified by employing the imprinting technique. The extinction ratio of polarizers fabricated is as high as 45dB together with an insertion loss lower than 0.5dB at around 2.3THz.

articleTitle: Compact SiGe HBT EO modulator for analog applications
abstract: This paper proposed a compact linearized SiGe HBT EO modulator for applications in analog signal processing. The length of the modulator is only 15 μm. Simulation shows that it possesses a SFDR of 42 dB.

articleTitle: Independent particle detection and tunable spectral filtering on optofluidic chip
abstract: Integration of a tunable optofluidic notch filter with a biosensing section on a single liquid-core waveguide chip is demonstrated. The filter response was fluidically tuned by 90nm with up to a 43dB rejection ratio.

articleTitle: Scaling of high harmonic generation with visible driver wavelengths
abstract: The wavelength scaling of high harmonic generation efficiency and cutoff is studied with different visible driver wavelengths from a tunable optical parametric amplifier. A λ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5.9</sup> scaling relation for the efficiency is measured.

articleTitle: Quantum benchmarks from any states of light
abstract: Quantum benchmarks allow us to discriminate between classical and quantum communication devices (e.g. quantum memories, repeaters, and cryptography systems). We show how to construct simple, effective benchmarks using any type of optical test states.

articleTitle: Al-doping in CsLiB6O10 for high resistance against UV laser-induced damage
abstract: Al-doped CsLiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> crystals were grown by the top-seeded solution growth method in large sizes with good optical quality. We reveal for the first time that these crystals exhibit outstanding UV-induced damage resistant performance.

articleTitle: Multi-cavity far infrared 2D plasmonic phenomena with inhomogeneous screening
abstract: We have observed coherent interaction of coupled far infrared 2D plasma cavities in a GaAs/AlGaAs FET. These results have been modeled with a transmission line formalism that treats both unscreened and screened 2D plasmons.

articleTitle: Scattering of electrons with acoustic phonons in singlewalled carbon nanotubes
abstract: We perform two-color pump-probe experiments on (8,7), (10,2), (11,3) and (12,1) nanotubes. The density matrix formalism reveals that the measured few picosecond component of the relaxation dynamics is due to intraband carrier-acoustic phonon scattering.

articleTitle: Optical refrigeration to NIST cryogenic temperature at 123K
abstract: A record low temperature in optical refrigeration is demonstrated by cooling Yb:YLF crystal to 128K ± 5K (∼-150 C) at λ=1020 nm corresponding to its E4-E5 Stark manifold resonance. The estimated cooling power is 165 mW.

articleTitle: Microresonator based optical frequency combs
abstract: Mid and near-IR optical frequency combs generation in ultra high Q crystalline and integrated SiN microcavities is presented. Moreover, universal dynamics that influences phase noise is described.

articleTitle: Few-cycle self-compression via multimode nonlinear optics in gas filled waveguides
abstract: Multimode simulations predict dramatic ionization-induced self-compression of high energy ultrashort pulses within short gas filled capillaries. The mechanism observed allows for the temporal compression of 53 fs pulses into the few-cycle regime.

articleTitle: Fabrication of large area photonic crystals with periodic defects by one-step phase-controlled holographic lithography
abstract: A one-step introduction of functional defects into a photonic crystal (PC) is demonstrated. By using a multi-beam phase-controlled holographic lithography and a diffracting optical element, large area one dimensional (1D) and two dimensional (2D) PCs with periodic defects was fabricated. The uniform area is up to 4 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Three dimensional photonic crystal with intrinsic defect can also be fabricated by this technique.

articleTitle: Cooperative phenomena in an ultradense electron-hole Magneto-plasma
abstract: We have performed ultrafast pump-probe and time-resolved photoluminescence experiments on highly excited semiconductor quantum wells in a high magnetic field, observing time-delayed suprefluorescence bursts of coherent radiation together with a sudden population drop from full inversion to zero.

articleTitle: Electrically controlled silicon nitride ring resonator for quasi-phase matched second-harmonic generation
abstract: We propose and simulate an electro-optical ring resonator for second-harmonic generation that is controlled by a dc field. Results predict -24.3dB conversion efficiency without need for external compensation of nonlinearity-induced resonance shift.

articleTitle: Blind bias compensation in speckle imaging
abstract: We present a method for blind bias compensation of the bispectrum in speckle-imaging applications using EMCCDs. Image reconstructions using this blind method are found to compare favorably with those produced using non-blind methods of bias compensation.

articleTitle: Milli-joule laser pulse delivery and spark ignition through kagome fiber
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time ns-laser spark ignition through kagome-type fibers in a friendly manner. The energy threshold damage is pushed over the 10mJ-level and the output power density is approaching TW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> after focusing.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical study of oxygen-sulfur squaraines
abstract: Replacing oxygen with sulfur in a squaraine bridge compound leads to a large increase in triplet yield (and triplet-state absorption) while maintaining the already enhanced two-photon absorption as well as the singlet excited-state absorption.

articleTitle: All-in-fiber liquid crystal cell
abstract: We report on the realization of a frequency-tunable all-in-fiber liquid crystal cell with built in electrodes that is demonstrated to modulate light incident transverse to its axis.

articleTitle: Direct photoluminescence observation of the negative Bogoliubov branch in an exciton-polariton condensate
abstract: Bose-Einstein condensates exhibit fascinating behavior such as superfluidity and vortex formation, effects owing their presence to self-interactions between the underlying bosons [1]. In exciton-polariton condensates another peculiar effect has been theoretically predicted, where the negative energy Bogoliubov dispersion becomes observable in the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum [2-5]. The effect originates from the anomalous mixing of creation and destruction operators of polaritons, which results in the creation of a Bogoliubov particle when the PL is observed. Here we directly observe the PL of the negative Bogoliubov dispersion branch for the first time in a high density regime far above the exciton-polariton condensation threshold. The observation is made possible by strong coupling being maintained at densities corresponding to ~ 100 times the threshold density for condensation. The presence of strong coupling at such densities is evidenced by second-order coherence and PL measurements showing clear differences to photon lasing, a weak coupling phenomenon. Comparison of the negative dispersion PL spectrum shows good agreement to theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Enhanced optical forces in hybrid plasmonic devices
abstract: We demonstrate that the optical force exerted on a suspended dielectric waveguide coupled to a metallic substrate is greatly enhanced compared to dielectric substrate, due to subwavelength optical energy confinement in the hybrid plasmonic mode.

articleTitle: Optical cross correlator in a silicon waveguide
abstract: We present a technique for performing single-shot optical cross-correlations in a silicon waveguide and show that it can be applied to the cross correlation of two 300-fs signals.

articleTitle: Cubic GaInN/GaN multi-quantum wells for increased smart lighting system efficiency
abstract: Cubic GaInN/GaN multi-quantum wells (MQWs) are grown on V-grooved Si {100} substrates. The crystal phase is confirmed by electron-back scatter diffraction and cathodoluminescence shows room temperature MQW peak emission at 498 nm.

articleTitle: Light emission in Ge quantum wells
abstract: We present the Ge/SiGe quantum well structure as a strong candidate for CMOS compatible light source. Photoluminescence and electroluminescence show enhanced optical properties over bulk Ge. Further optical enhancement is observed in disk resonators.

articleTitle: A slot-Suzuki-Phase photonic crystal for optical trapping via guided resonance modes
abstract: A novel photonic crystal design is proposed for optical trapping of particle arrays. The design introduces a slot in the unit cell of the Suzuki-Phase lattice to increase quality factor and trapping strength.

articleTitle: Intrinsic speed limit of graphene-based photodetectors
abstract: In this contribution, we present measurements of the intrinsic speed limit of graphene photodetectors using ultrashort laser pulses. We obtain a bandwidth of 262 GHz, showing the great potential of graphene for high-speed optoelectronics.

articleTitle: Multiple ionization of atoms and molecules by an intense isolated attosecond pulse
abstract: We investigated multiple ionization process in atoms and molecules by an intense isolated attosecond pulse. Observed Ne<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> signal guarantees that our IAP sources are strong enough to create the nonlinear phenomena.

articleTitle: Secure quantum imaging
abstract: We propose two different active imaging schemes that are secure against manipulation of the imaging photons by the object being imaged. These schemes are based on the BB84 and Ekert protocols used in QKD.

articleTitle: Transport of trapped-ion qubits in a scalable architecture
abstract: Trapped-ion qubits can be transported through a two-dimensional trap array, while maintaining the ions near the motional ground-state. This helps demonstrate the viability of large-scale quantum processor architectures using trapped-ions.

articleTitle: Observation of plasmonic mirages
abstract: Fabrication of dielectric structures with variable thickness on top of a gold film by grey-scale lithography allows controlling the effective refractive-index profiles for surface plasmon polaritons. As an example, we demonstrate plasmonic mirages.

articleTitle: Development of a low-loss, non-critically phase-matched, 1-μm-pumpable ZGP analog for the mid-infrared
abstract: Here we report on recent advances in the development of orientation-patterned gallium phosphide (OP-GaP) - a low loss, non-critically phase-matched, 1-μm-pumpable binary analog of ZGP with three times the thermal conductivity for high power applications.

articleTitle: Tailoring quantum-correlated two-photon transitions to excitons in semiconductor quantum wells
abstract: Dependence of excitonic two-photon absorption on the quantum correlations of exciting biphotons in a semiconductor quantum well is studied. We found that exciton oscillator strengths increase when photons arrive simultaneously in entangled states.

articleTitle: Milliwatt-level mid-infrared difference frequency generation with a femtosecond dual-signal-wavelength optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report on mid-infrared difference frequency generation with a dual-signal-wavelength femtosecond optical parametric oscillator. We achieved up to 1.2 mW average power at 42 MHz at wavelengths tunable between 11 and 18 μm.

articleTitle: Anisotropic plasmonic sensing of individual or coupled gold nanorods
abstract: Plasmonic sensing ability of individual or coupled nanorods is anisotropically distributed, and the sensitivity of the nanorod plasmonic sensor can be tailored, concentrated, and locally enhanced.

articleTitle: One-step multi-material preform extrusion for robust chalcogenide glass optical fibers and tapers
abstract: We demonstrate a novel process of one-step extrusion of multi-material fiber preforms containing chalcogenide glasses and polymers. The polymer lends mechanical robustness to the drawn chalcogenide infrared fibers and tapers.

articleTitle: Over an octave of infrared supercontinuum generation in robust multi-material chalcogenide nano-tapers
abstract: We demonstrate infrared supercontinuum generation over more than one octave (0.85-2.35 μm) produced using a low-power 1.5-μm picosecond laser in robust multi-material step-index chalcogenide fiber nano-tapers with high index contrast.

articleTitle: 60% FHG efficiency from fluxless-grown BBO using Nd:YAG/Cr4+:YAG microchip laser
abstract: Fourth harmonic generation from a linearly polarized Nd:YAG/Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG microchip laser, achieving 3.4 MW peak power, 250 ps, 100 Hz pulses at 266 nm, is obtained using fluxless-grown BBO with 60% conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Bright single photon emission from a quantum dot in a circular dielectric grating
abstract: We demonstrate a single photon source based on a single quantum dot in a circular grating microcavity and measure a collection efficiency of 10%. Tradeoffs between suppressed multi-photon probability and Purcell enhancement are investigated.

articleTitle: Ultra sensitive surface-enhanced Raman scattering detection using uniform sub-5 nm gap optical antennas
abstract: Arch-dipole optical antennas with uniform 5nm gaps have been fabricated on Si substrate using deep-UV “spacer” lithography. Strong surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) signals with an enhancement factor of 1.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> have been measured.

articleTitle: Plasmon-assisted energy transfer near metal nanoparticles
abstract: A unified theory of plasmon-assisted resonance energy transfer (RET) between molecules near a metal nanostructure is developed. In a wide range of parameters, RET is dominated by plasmon-enhanced radiative transfer rather than by nonradiative transfer mechanism.

articleTitle: Label-free second harmonic generation holographic imaging of biological specimens at speeds up to 1000 volumes per second
abstract: High-speed 3D images of biological tissues are captured with a label-free second harmonic generation holographic microscope. Speeds of up to 1000 image volumes per second are achieved and 3D particle tracking is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Highly linear electro-optic polymer based traveling wave MMI-fed directional coupler modulator
abstract: We demonstrate an EO polymer based traveling-wave MMI-fed directional-coupler modulator. High-speed and linear operation is demonstrated with bandwidth-length product of 125GHz·cm, the 3-dB electrical bandwidth of 10GHz, and the SFDR of 110±3dB/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Attosecond pulse trains generated with oriented molecules
abstract: We report the measurement of high harmonics from oriented molecules in the gas phase. We show that attosecond and re-collision science provides a detailed and sensitive probe of electronic asymmetry in polar molecules.

articleTitle: Transient measurement of laser wakefield at the SILEX-I: Ti: Sapphire laser
abstract: Based on single-shot spectral interferometry, transient measuring technology of laser wakefield at the SILEX-I: Ti: Sapphire Laser is developed. The wakefield is captured with ~140 fs resolution over a temporal region of 1 ps.

articleTitle: Four-state discrimination scheme beyond the heterodyne limit
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a hybrid discrimination scheme for the quadrature phase shift keying protocol, which outperforms heterodyne detection for any signal power. The discrimination is composed of a quadrature measurement, feed forward and photon detection.

articleTitle: Ripples induced by continuous ultraviolet laser exposure in soda-lime glass
abstract: Ripples of period about 150 nm, formed at the surface of a silica-based glass, are reported. Our glass behaves like a metallic glass due to the formation of highly concentrated silver nanoparticles.

articleTitle: In vivo three-photon microscopy of subcortical structures within an intact mouse brain
abstract: We demonstrate non-invasive, high-resolution, in vivo imaging of subcortical structures (the external capsule (EC) and hippocampus) within an intact mouse brain using three-photon fluorescence microscopy at the new spectral window of 1700 nm.

articleTitle: Towards frequency-coded qdits manipulation using coherent four-wave mixing
abstract: We demonstrate that the process of coherent four-wave mixing can be used to frequency shift on-demand single photons into several frequency bins.

articleTitle: RF-amplifier-free coupled optoelectronic oscillator (COEO)
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a RF-amplifier-free 10 GHz coupled optoelectronic oscillator (COEO) through use of high-power slab-coupled optical waveguide (SCOW) amplifier and photodiode components.

articleTitle: Observation of optically excited mechanical vibrations in a fluid containing microresonator
abstract: We experimentally show mechanical vibrations that are excited by radiation pressure in a fluid containing silica resonator. Vibrations at rates from 8 to 140 MHz are measured while liquid or gas is inside the resonator.

articleTitle: Novel in-situ calibrations for open-path ammonia sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time calibration of open-path ammonia sensing with an ethylene reference cell. Different harmonic WMS signals separate ethylene and ammonia so that ethylene signal varies within 1% under ambient ammonia concentration.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanocircuitry with embedded subwavelength waveguides and Yagi-style antennas
abstract: High confinement in plasmonic waveguides usually comes along with high loss. We present experiments on a new approach, which allows to tune adiabatically between high confinement and low loss waveguides, connected to optical Yagi-style antennas.

articleTitle: Rapid diagnosis of breast cancer cell with coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microspectroscopy
abstract: A CARS microspectroscopy system was developed and applied to live breast cancer cells. CARS image and spectrum at C-H vibration stretching in lipid droplets differentiate cancer cell from normal cell.

articleTitle: Multi-gigahertz-spaced frequency comb generation using optical pulse synthesizer for extra-solar planet finder
abstract: We propose a novel supercontinuum generator using an optical pulse synthesizer. A 12.5 GHz-spaced optical frequency comb spanning 280 nm has been successfully generated.

articleTitle: Side opened microstructured optical fiber based surface plasmon resonance biochip
abstract: A side-opened, metal film-coated microstructured optical fiber based SPR biochip for high sensitive label-free point-of-care test is studied, which possesses the characteristics of integration, easy of fabrication and a minimal index resolution of 2.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> R.I.U.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of a single-shot spectro-polarimeter
abstract: We show an implementation of a spectrally resolving single-shot polarimeter, without any moving parts and few functional components. The functional principle and the setup as well as optimizations of the system will be presented.

articleTitle: Shot-noise-limited, real-time Raman spectroscopy using time-correlated photon-counting detection
abstract: Highly sensitive, shot-noise-limited Raman signal acquisition was achieved using frequency-time transformation in a single-mode fiber and time-correlated photon counting system.

articleTitle: Polarization/time-bin basis conversion of entangled photons
abstract: We describe a scheme for interconverting photonic entanglement between time-bin and polarization bases. This scheme makes entangled pairs insensitive to birefringement effects and thus has application in fiber-based quantum memories.

articleTitle: Multiphoton multifoci modulation microscopy for high-speed fluorescence lifetime imaging
abstract: We demonstrate a novel depth-resolved parallel-acquisition fluorescence lifetime imaging technique, and present in-vivo images of mouse brain. Analysis shows up to two orders-of-magnitude speed improvement over standard serial-acquisition techniques.

articleTitle: Room temperature plasmon nanolaser
abstract: We report plasmon lasers with strong cavity feedback and optical confinement to 1/20th wavelength. Strong feedback arises from total internal reflection of plasmons, while confinement enhances the spontaneous emission rate by up to 20 times.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of tightly focused beams using Mie-scattering
abstract: By using a sub-wavelength nano-particle as a field probe and a tailored detection scheme we are able to reconstruct the electric energy density in the focal plane of a high numerical aperture focusing system.

articleTitle: Quantum information device based on NV diamond centers for quantum network
abstract: We propose a model of quantum information devices based on an optical cavity with an NV centre. These devices can be easily modified to accommodate imperfections such as photon loss, maintaining the feasibility and scalability.

articleTitle: A general threshold for laser-driven linear particle acceleration in infinite vacuum
abstract: We derive a threshold formula for unbounded vacuum acceleration by hypothesizing that this is possible only if the field perturbs the particle relativistically in its initial rest frame. Numerical simulations support our formula and hypothesis.

articleTitle: Integrated lasers for polymer Lab-on-a-Chip systems
abstract: We develop optical Lab-on-a-Chips on different platforms for marker-based and label-free biophotonic sensor applications. Our chips are based on polymers and fabricated by mass production technologies to integrate microfluidic channels, optical waveguides and miniaturized lasers.

articleTitle: Room temperature lasing in 6mm-diameter quantum dot microring laser on GaAs substrate
abstract: Room-temperature lasing around 1.3-μm was achieved under optical pumping in 6-μm diameter microrings with InAs/InGaAs quantum dots and AlGaO pedestal MBE-grown on GaAs substrate.

articleTitle: Off-resonance plasmonic enhanced laser (ORPEL) nanoprocessing: Fundamentals and application to cell transfection
abstract: ORPEL nanoprocessing is based on the production of a highly localized plasma due to the enhanced scattering field. Using a 800 nm fs laser, ORPEL was employed to efficiently perforate cell membranes and transfect cells.

articleTitle: Broadening of fundamental resonance via nested resonators in terahertz metamaterial
abstract: We demonstrate broadening of fundamental resonance by successive insertion of rings inside of a split ring resonator (SRR) in a nested fashion. With the maximum inner rings, the resonance linewidth broadens by factor of four.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional photocurrent control in air plasma for optimized terahertz generation
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) transverse photocurrent generation is detailed for terahertz energy and polarization control in two-color, laser-produced air filaments. A full control of terahertz output is demonstrated and in good agreement with our 2D photocurrent model.

articleTitle: Generation of 32-fs pulses at 780 nm by frequency doubling the solitonically-compressed output of an Erbium-doped fiber-laser system
abstract: The 80-fs pulses generated by an Erbium-doped fiber-laser system are solitonically compressed down to 27 fs using a standard polarization maintaining fiber. After frequency doubling and compression 32 fs pulses with an average power of 61 mW are generated at a wavelength of 780 nm.

articleTitle: Observation of Anderson co-localization of spatially entangled photon pairs
abstract: We report the first observation of Anderson co-localization of spatially entangled photon pairs propagating through random optical waveguide lattices with controllable off-diagonal disorder.

articleTitle: Phase elements for surface optics
abstract: We demonstrate that plasmonic two-oscillator elements such as V- and Y-shaped antennas can locally tailor the phase of light over 2π. A theoretical model and full-wave simulations explain the measured spectral response of these elements.

articleTitle: Properties of broadband terahertz generation in birefringent ZnGeP2
abstract: Generation of terahertz pulses by optical rectification is demonstrated in chalcopyrite ZnGeP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> (ZGP) as a function of pump intensity, wavelength and crystal orientation. For infrared excitation, ZGP emission exceeds that of GaAs and GaP.

articleTitle: Time domain study of on-chip microresonator frequency combs
abstract: We report time domain properties of microresonator combs formed with the initial sidebands spaced by multiple free spectral ranges that then fill in to give combs with single free-spectral-range spacing.

articleTitle: Photons on demand from an electrically driven single quantum dot under pulsed excitation
abstract: For a single quantum dot under excitation with short electrical pulses the dependence of the photon anti-bunching on pulse width and excitation strength is studied in a theory-experiment collaboration.

articleTitle: 3190–3275 nm tuneable, room temperature, external cavity InAs/AlSb Quantum Cascade Laser
abstract: We demonstrated a room temperature, tuneable, external cavity Quantum Cascade Laser for the use in compact spectroscopic gas sensing system. Wavelength tuning of 85 nm between 3190 nm and 3275 nm was achieved at room temperature.

articleTitle: Dynamics of a tethered silicon photonic crystal membrane due to optical gradient, photothermal and Casimir forces
abstract: We experimentally studied the effects of optical gradient and photothermal forces on the optomechanics of tethered silicon membranes. Novel engineering of support arms facilitates tunable optomechanical coupling and probing of Casimir interactions.

articleTitle: Bottle beam generation from fiber-based Bessel beams
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber method to generate a 28um × 6.5um optical bottle using coherent superpositions of fiber-grating-based Bessel beams. Our method enables precise beam control by tuning the relative modal weight and phase of the two beams.

articleTitle: Scattering optics resolve nanostructure
abstract: Multiple scattering of light is exploited to realize a novel kind of lens. Controlling light propagation we generate a scanning nanosized optical focus and achieve a resolution of 97 nm.

articleTitle: Generation of tunable narrowband terahertz pulses from coherent transition radiation
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of tunable, narrow-band, few-cycle and multi-cycle terahertz pulses from a temporally modulated relativistic electron beam through coherent transition radiation.

articleTitle: Spectrally flat, broadband visible-wavelength astro-comb
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband visible-wavelength astro-comb enabled by two key technologies: dispersion-managed, fiber-optic Cherenkov radiation for green-to-red source-comb generation and complementary chirped-mirror pairs for constructing broadband Fabry-Perot filtering cavities.

articleTitle: Silicon nanowire based optical XOR logic gate at 40Gb/s for DPSK data
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical XOR logic function for 40Gb/s DPSK signals in the C-band, based on four-wave mixing (FWM) in a silicon nanowire. Error-free operation with a system penalty of ~4.3dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER has been achieved.

articleTitle: All optical passive stabilization of a two-section InAs/InP based quantum-dash mode-locked laser with simultaneous CW injection-locking and selective optical feedback
abstract: We demonstrate narrow pulses with low RF linewidth from two-section InP quantum-dash mode-locked lasers. Simultaneous CW injection-locking and selective optical feedback lead to ≃50 times RF linewidth and 1.5 times time-bandwidth product reduction.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of dispersion-managed soliton interaction
abstract: Fiber-optic dispersion-managed solitons can form stable molecules. Systematically mapping out parameter space using a flexible pulse shaper, we investigate the binding mechanism and confirm predictions. Phenomena off equilibrium are also described and explained.

articleTitle: Extraordinarily high spectral sensitivity in refractive index sensors using multiple optical modes
abstract: We show that high spectral sensitivity in surface plasmon resonance sensor is due to the multi-mode nature of the sensing scheme. Multi-mode sensing can be applied to dielectric systems to achieve similar extraordinary spectral sensitivity.

articleTitle: Wavelength shifting of a 21.4-Gbaud 16-QAM signal using highly nonlinear silica fiber
abstract: Longitudinal stress reduces the stimulated-Brillouin-scattering threshold in a silica-fiber parametric amplifier, allowing ditherless pumping. This enables phase conjugation of a 21.4-Gbaud 16-QAM signal with less than 0.6-dB penalty.

articleTitle: Imaging resonant modes in photonic crystal nanocavity by atomic force microscope nano-oxidation
abstract: Electric field distributions of resonant modes in a photonic crystal nanocavity were imaged using atomic force microscope nano-oxidation. A grid pattern of nano-size oxides was grown on the nanocavity to perturb the resonant modes. The perturbation caused a shift in the resonant wavelength that was proportional to the local electric field intensity of the resonant mode. The experimentally obtained field intensity images agreed excellently with the finite-difference time-domain calculations. The measured resonant mode images had high spatial resolution and image contrast, owing to the extremely local perturbation of the atomic force microscope oxidation technique.

articleTitle: Angular sliced Laguerre-Gaussian (LG) beams to increase the channel number in spatial-mode multiplexed system
abstract: An angular sliced LG beam rotates +90 or -90 degree and maintains the fan shape and spiral phase in the far field. It enables a new scheme of spatial-mode division multiplexing system in free space communication.

articleTitle: On-off keyed microwave signal optically generated using an optically-injected Fabry-Perot semiconductor laser
abstract: Large-signal direct-modulation of a diode laser optically-injected into period-one operation is shown to produce an on-off keyed microwave signal. The signal is highly tunable and transmitted over 50 km, suitable for radio-over-fiber applications.

articleTitle: Instantaneous release of broadband terahertz radiation trapped by periodic arrays of split-ring resonators
abstract: We demonstrate that broadband terahertz radiation can be trapped by periodic arrays of split-ring resonators and released instantaneously by means of optical absorption. Such phenomena can open up novel applications.

articleTitle: Incoherent embedded solitons
abstract: We show that a partially coherent beam can be self-trapped into an incoherent soliton with all its coherent components embedded in the continuum. Incoherent embedded solitons display distinctive power spectrum and coherence properties.

articleTitle: Frequency conversion in the visible and UV regions of a high average power and high peak power ultrafast fiber amplifier
abstract: In this contribution, we report on the frequency conversion into the visible and UV region of a high average power and high energy ultrafast fiber amplifier. The laser uses a very compact chirped pulse fiber amplifier architecture that delivers as much as 385 μJ of energy and 1 GW of peak power per pulse. It includes only one power amplifier composed of a state-of-the-art photonic crystal fiber which allows operation at high repetition rate (>; 100 kHz) and high average power (~ 100W). Subsequent frequency conversion is demonstrated and up to 150 μJ, 90 μJ and 35 μJ are achieved at, respectively, 515 nm, 343 nm and 258 nm for a maximum of 250 μJ at the fundamental wavelength. Additionally, recent results will be presented focusing on average power rather than energy for which 50 W at 515 nm and 25 W at 343 nm will be presented.

articleTitle: Homodyne near-degenerate four-wave-mixing microscopy for graphene imaging and biomedical applications
abstract: Homodyne detection of near-degenerate four-wave-mixing with a single laser pulse is used to imaging graphene in biological samples.

articleTitle: Unconditional conversion between a single-photon state and a coherent-state superposition via squeezing operation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a conversion of a single-photon state into a superposition of two weak coherent states and its inverse, via squeezing operation based on offline-prepared squeezed states, measurement and feedforward.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-50-fs pulses in the near infrared by optical parametric amplifiers based on BIBO crystals
abstract: 800-nm pumped BIBO OPAs using Type-I and Type-II phase-matching are investigated and compared for achieving sub-50-fs pulses in the NIR. The OPAs achieve their shortest pulse durations of 19.8fs and 41.3fs, respectively, at 1.8μm.

articleTitle: All-fiber 10-GHz picosecond-pulse generation at 1.9 μm without mode-locking
abstract: I generate 3.6 ps 10-GHz pulses at 1877 nm in an all-fiber package without mode-locking. To the best of my knowledge, this shows the highest repetition rate for all-fiber ultrafast pulse generation near 2.0 μm.

articleTitle: Impact of phase-sensitive-amplifier's mode structure on amplified image quality
abstract: We study phase-sensitive image pre-amplification versus pumping conditions and number of signal modes. We see image improvement by pre-amplification, and high-spatial-frequency enhancement for “higher-order-pump,” “nonzero-wavevector-mismatch” cases.

articleTitle: Determining the lower limit of human vision using a single-photon source
abstract: We discuss the use of a source of single photons to investigate possible single-photon vision in humans.

articleTitle: Fiber-format picosecond source for coherent Raman microscopy
abstract: We present a fiber-based source for coherent Raman microscopy. Picosecond frequency conversion is achieved by normal dispersion four-wave mixing in photonic crystal fiber, yielding nanojoule pulses with 2800-3200 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> frequency differences.

articleTitle: Polarization characteristics of a two-mirror azimuth and elevation laser beam scanner
abstract: A miniature lidar beam steering unit was developed and used to determine the effect of the mirror coatings on the transmitted state of polarization. Results will be presented for pairs of mirrors with different coatings.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact integrated optical auto-correlator based on third-harmonic generation in Si photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon chip-based all-optical device providing single shot time-domain measurements of picosecond pulses near λ=1550nm. The auto-correlation visible signal arises from third-harmonic generation in a 96 μm long slow light photonic crystal waveguide.

articleTitle: High-resolution photoluminescence spectroscopy of near-surface nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond
abstract: Spectral diffusion is a critical problem affecting quantum devices based on nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond. Here we report sub-GHz photoluminescence emission spectroscopy of near-surface nitrogen-vacancy centers in several types of samples.

articleTitle: High energy 4.1–4.6 μm Fe:ZnSe laser
abstract: We report to the best of our knowledge the highest output energy (0.42J) of Fe:ZnSe operating at 4.14 μm. The lasing wavelength varied from 4.14 μm at 77K to 4.65 μm at 220K.

articleTitle: On-chip transmission of non-classical light from an integrated quantum emitter
abstract: We report the on-chip transmission of single photons emitted by a semiconductor quantum dot coupled to a photonic crystal waveguide. Autocorrelation measurements show strong multiphoton suppression. The device efficiency is 24% under optical pumping.

articleTitle: Demonstration of non-monotonic quantum to classical transition in multiparticle interference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the non-monotonic dependence of many-particle interference signals on the particles mutual distinguishability. Such non-monotonicity is a generic feature of the quantum to classical transition in multiparticle systems.

articleTitle: Highly efficient GaAs solar cells with dual layer of quantum dots and a flexible PDMS film
abstract: High performance of GaAs solar cell with dual layer quantum dots separated by flexible polydimethylsiloxane film was demonstrated. By this scheme, the efficiency increased by 22%, compared to the cell without QDs.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband, efficient and unidirectional random-nanoslits coupler for metal-insulator-metal plasmons
abstract: A novel type of compact and unidirectional optical coupler composed of random nanoslits is proposed for metal-insulator-metal plasmons with coupling efficiency more than 40% over an ultra-broad spectral range from 1260nm to 1675nm.

articleTitle: Mid-IR optical amplifications using resonant gain of quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Using quantum-cascade-lasers (QCL) as resonant optical amplifiers, active filters, and detectors with gain, we demonstrated signal amplification in the mid-IR wavelength range. Optical gain of >;10dB and electrical gain of >;28dB were achieved.

articleTitle: Cryogenic, conduction cooled, end pumped, zigzag slab laser, suitable for power scaling
abstract: Thermo mechanical and thermo optical properties of Yb:YAG improve significantly at cryogenic temperatures. We present the first end pumped, zigzag slab Yb:YAG geometry, which is cryogenically conduction cooled, robust, and power scalable.

articleTitle: Highly localized plasma formation in air using space-time cusing of mJ ultrafast pulses
abstract: Space-time focusing of spatially-chirped Ti:Sapphire laser pulses is used to generate a plasma in air axially localized to 28× less than the confocal parameter, suppressing filamentation on the way to the focus.

articleTitle: External ring-cavity quantum cascade lasers for mode-locking and atmospheric sensing
abstract: An external ring-cavity quantum cascade laser is demonstrated and investigated for the first time. Applications in mode-locking and atmospheric sensing are discussed, and a preliminary experimental characterization of the ring laser is presented.

articleTitle: Triple resonant four-wave mixing: A microwatt continuous-wave laser source in the vacuum ultraviolet region at 120 nm
abstract: We present a vacuum ultraviolet laser source by four-wave mixing in mercury vapour based on solid-state laser systems. Maximum powers of 6μW were achieved with an increase of four orders of magnitude in efficiency.

articleTitle: In-line reference cell for real-time calibration of laser absorption spectrometers
abstract: We discuss a novel method of tunable diode laser sensor calibration using an in-line reference gas cell. The technique employs wavelength modulation spectroscopy at higher harmonics to simultaneously probe the sample and reference spectra.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in an individual Fano resonator metamaterial
abstract: We observe metamaterial induced transparency in a single Fano resonator array. In a perfect symmetric configuration, a broad dipolar resonance is excited whereas a high Q transparency window opens as the structural symmetry is broken.

articleTitle: Optimization of the 3D non-paraxial illumination volume for multiphoton florescence microscopy
abstract: We present a new approach for optimizing a 3D non-paraxial volume for multiphoton florescence microscopy. Our optimized solutions demonstrate volume reduction of up to 6.5, compared to the best current design for three-photon microscopy.

articleTitle: Strongly enhanced fluorescence decay rates on multilayered plasmonic metamaterials
abstract: We report strongly enhanced fluorescence decay rates on Ag/Si multilayered plasmonic metamaterials, with tunability and broader bandwidths than on Ag single-layer nanostructures. Time-resolved fluorescence measures a 54-fold decay rate enhancement.

articleTitle: Fully efficient adiabatic downconversion of broadband Ti:Sapphire oscillator pulses
abstract: We demonstrate adiabatic downconversion of a 110-nm band from a Ti:sapphire oscillator to the infrared, spanning 1550-2450 nm, with near-100% efficiency. The technique can potentially deliver multi-octave-spanning pulses for parametric amplification.

articleTitle: Real-time dual-comb spectroscopy of iodine in the visible
abstract: Dual-comb spectroscopy is extended to the visible range. The dense rovibronic spectrum of iodine around 520 nm is measured within 12 ms at Doppler-limited resolution with a scheme that only uses free-running lasers.

articleTitle: Fresnel-regime coherent diffractive imaging using a tabletop soft x-ray source
abstract: Coherent x-ray diffractive imaging (CXDI) is a powerful technique for wavelength-limited, ultrafast images. We present a novel analysis and demonstration of Fresnel-regime (near field) CXDI with a tabletop 13 nm high harmonic generation source.

articleTitle: Double-slit diffraction experiment in hyperbolic media
abstract: Our experiment demonstrates a subwavelength-wide peak from double-slit diffraction inside a slab with hyperbolic dispersion; this highly localized field can be used for subwavelength probes.

articleTitle: Optimization of rare-earth modified iron garnet epitaxial films for magneto-optic applications
abstract: Epitaxial CeBiIG and CeYIG films were grown on (100)-oriented Gd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> substrates by pulse laser deposition. We achieved strong FR of 0.65 deg/μm and 0.52 deg/μm at 1.55 μm for epitaxial CeBiIG and CeYIG films, respectively.

articleTitle: 99-μm-long-cavity laser diode using highly stacked InGaAs quantum dots
abstract: We fabricated a 99-μm-long-cavity broad-area laser diode involving 19 stacked InGaAs quantum dots, which lased at 1013 nm without any HR coating, and the threshold current density was 2.25 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: High-efficient THz electric pulse generation via optical rectification by suppressing stimulated Raman scattering
abstract: We demonstrate high-efficient THz pulse generation with optical rectification in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. Narrowed spectral bandwidth of subpicosecond optical excitation pulse suppresses stimulated Raman scattering, leading to the highest energy conversion efficiency of 0.21 % into THz pulse.

articleTitle: Artificial compound eyes fabricated by femtosecond laser-enhanced chemical etching and soft replication
abstract: Reported herein is a new method to produce artificial compound eyes, which involves a femtosecond laser fabrication and soft replication. A meso-scale hemispherical shell covered with 10,200 hexagonal-shaped and gapless microlenses is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low insertion losses and high drop efficiency photonic crystal filter for advanced telecom modulation formats
abstract: A 2D photonic crystal 3-ports filter with 6 dB bus insertion losses and drop efficiency of 47 % is reported. Error-free operation with low penalty (<;0.5 dB) for OOK and DQPSK modulation formats is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficient lasing with nanocrystal quantum dots using Purcell effect to overcome Auger recombination
abstract: We theoretically investigate the use of small mode-volume cavity in overcoming Auger recombination in NQDs by Purcell enhancement, and show lasing with high output efficiency (>;0.75) and high spontaneous emission coupling factor (>;0.9).

articleTitle: Strong photon bunching in individual nanocrystal quantum dots coupled to rough silver film
abstract: We demonstrate that sub-Poissonian statistics (photon antibunching) of photon emission from individual core-shell quantum dots can be transformed to super-Poissonian statistics (photon bunching) by coupling dots to a rough silver film.

articleTitle: High efficiency GaN-based light emitting diodes with embedded air voids/SiO2 nanomasks
abstract: We fabricated high efficiency LEDs with embedded micro-scale air voids and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanomask exhibit smaller reverse-bias current and great enhancement of the light output (65% at 20mA) compared with the conventional LEDs.

articleTitle: Tellurite composite microstructured optical fibers with ultra-flattened, near-zero dispersion profile for nonlinear applications
abstract: We report tellurite composite microstructured optical fibers with small core surrounded by air holes and two glass claddings with low refractive index. In which near zero, ultra-flattened dispersion is realized.

articleTitle: Ultrafast imaging of terahertz pulse generation by tilted optical pulse front in LiNbO3
abstract: We directly image terahertz waves generated by optical rectification of tilted-pulse-front optical pulses in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The terahertz generation efficiency is highest when the pump-pulse tilt angle is equal to the THz Cherenkov angle.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional chiral plasmonic oligomers
abstract: We demonstrate a chiral optical response in stacked arrangements of resonantly coupled plasmonic nanostructures possessing the capability to encode their 3D arrangement in unique spectra making then ideal candidates for a 3D chiral plasmonic ruler.

articleTitle: Key laser technologies for next generation x-ray sources
abstract: Advances in femtosecond lasers and ultrafast optical techniques may lead to the construction of fully coherent soft and hard x-ray sources with unprecedented coherence, peak brightness and temporal control. Key laser technologies enabling this progress are reviewed.

articleTitle: Angular momentum conservation in plasmonics
abstract: A complete understanding of angular momentum in plasmonic phenomena is lacking in the optics literature. The role of angular momentum conservation in plasmonics in nano-scale metallic spheres and wires provides new ways to exploit plasmonic response.

articleTitle: Distributed feedback fiber laser employing Brillouin gain
abstract: A single frequency distributed feedback Brillouin fiber laser exhibiting a threshold of 30 mW, and pump-to-Stokes conversion efficiency of 27% is shown. The Brillouin laser operates over a pump frequency detuning range exceeding 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Efficient distributed feedback dye laser in silk fibroin films
abstract: We observed longitudinal single-mode operation in a distributed feedback dye laser consisting of silk fibroin films doped with Rhodamine 6G dye and infiltrated with silica or silver nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Organic/inorganic hybrid pixelless near infrared imaging device
abstract: We report a highly simplified single-mesa organic/inorganic hybrid near-infrared-to-visible imaging upconversion device (spatial resolution ~10 μm). This device integrates an intrinsic-InGaAs substrate and an organic light emitting diode.

articleTitle: Stamp printing of silicon nanomembrane based flexible photonic devices
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time stamp printing of silicon nanomembrane based photonic devices onto flexible substrate utilizing protection layer and suspended configuration. The propagation loss of the transferred waveguide is ~1.1dB/cm.

articleTitle: A three-primary-color continuous-wave laser generated through intracavity Raman-resonant four-wave mixing
abstract: A continuous-wave multicolor laser with wavelengths of 436, 532 and 683 nm is developed. These lines are generated through stimulated Raman scattering and Raman-resonant four-wave mixing in hydrogen molecules in a broadband optical cavity.

articleTitle: Microcavity polaritons: Quantum fluid phenomena and optoelectronic applications
abstract: Polaritons are composite bosons which behave as a new type of quantum fluid: its specific properties will be presented in detail. Moreover, the strong potential for the realization of polariton-based optoelectronic devices will be discussed.

articleTitle: Widely and continuously tuneable liquid crystal lasers
abstract: Liquid crystal lasers offer wide, continuous tuneability across the visible and near-infrared (450-850 nm). Compared to conventional tuneable laser technology, liquid crystal lasers are highly compact and have simple and scalable manufacturability. Their ability to emit multiple simultaneous emissions of arbitrarily selectable wavelength also gives them functional advantages over competing technologies. This paper describes Förster transfer techniques that have enabled this extended continuously tunable emission range, whilst maintaining a common pump source.

articleTitle: Study of optical anisotropy of c-plane/m-plane ultra-violet LED and Laser diode by k·p method
abstract: The optical anisotropic characteristics of AlGaN based quantum well UV LED are studied in this paper by k·p method. A polarization switch is observed when Al composition is larger than 50% for the c-plane case. And for the non-polar structure, the light polarization direction is mainly dominated by X' polarized light, which is good for LED or Laser applications.

articleTitle: Microfluidic pressure measurements with optical trapping
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique to measure pressure in microfluidic chips using optical trapping. The pressure drop across a single oil or water droplet is determined from the position of an optically-trapped bead.

articleTitle: Storing an optical pulse as a mechanical excitation in a silica optomechanical resonator
abstract: We report an experimental demonstration of storing an optical pulse as a mechanical excitation in a silica microsphere. The storage lifetime is determined by the relatively long damping time of the mechanical excitation.

articleTitle: Coherent beam combination of fiber laser arrays via multiplexed volume Bragg gratings
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of active coherently combining of fiber laser arrays with multiplexed volume Bragg gratings up to 70W combined output power with diffraction limited beam quality achieved at 82% combining efficiency.

articleTitle: Hollow beam creation with continuous diffractive phase mask at PHELIX
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a method for shaping the focus of high intensity lasers into an annular or “donut” mode. The method, based on helical phase plates, has been implemented at the PHELIX laser facility.

articleTitle: Optical control of the quality factor using coupled photonic crystal cavities
abstract: We have demonstrated optical control of quality-factor (Q-factor) using coupled photonic crystal cavities. A double heterostructure (DHS) cavity has been thermo-optically brought in resonance to an adjacent Febry-Pérot cavity to reduce the optical confinement and hence decrease the Q-factor. Both the strong and weak coupling phenomena between two cavities have been studied. Up to 50% Q-factor change has been experimentally observed. The corresponding modification of the local density of states enables the control of the spontaneous emission rate of the quantum emitters in the DHS cavity.

articleTitle: Top-down formation of vertically-aligned silicon nanowire bundles for tuning optical and field emission properties
abstract: We report a top-down strategy for realizing vertically-aligned silicon nanowire bundles which provide the controllability of surface reflectance by tuning the bundle parameters and superior field emission performance by reducing the screening effect.

articleTitle: Analytical comparison of Raman and photoluminescence enhancement by metal nanoparticles
abstract: We present a comparative study on the enhancement of photoluminescence and Raman processes by a single metal nanoparticle. Taking an analytical approach, we show the physics behind strikingly different orders of magnitude in enhancement that have been observed, provide fundamental explanation for not observing quenching of Raman process, and outline the path to optimization of both photoluminescence and Raman enhancement.

articleTitle: All-optical switching for dynamic wavelength routing of 100G Pol-Mux QPSK data
abstract: Simultaneous wavelength conversion and channel drop operation for 112 Gb/s polarization-multiplexed QPSK signals is demonstrated by using a single SOA-MZI controlled by an optical gate signal. After coherent detection, low OSNR penalty is measured.

articleTitle: Fully spatially coherent high harmonic beams in the keV region of the spectrum
abstract: Using a 3.9μm driving laser focused into a high-pressure gas-filled waveguide, we generate bright, phase matched, fully spatially coherent high harmonic beams in the keV region for the first time.

articleTitle: Ultrafast x-ray spectroscopic and scattering studies of nanoscale superionic phase transitions
abstract: Ultrafast x-ray absorption spectroscopy and diffraction techniques are used to directly record the superionic structural phase transition in nanoscale copper sulfide.

articleTitle: High-Q THz Fano resonance in concentric ring apertures
abstract: We show a sharp Fano resonance when terahertz waves pass through two concentric ring apertures in a metal film. A high-Q and intensive dark mode is indirectly excited by coupling to a low-Q bright mode.

articleTitle: Self-imaging through a disordered waveguide lattice
abstract: We demonstrate that the eigenmodes of a waveguide array with disorder in the coupling between adjacent guides are pairwise conjugated. Therefore, self-imaging via phase-segmentation is inherently insensitive to such an off-diagonal disorder.

articleTitle: Balanced-detection Raman induced Kerr effect microscopy
abstract: We introduce balanced-detection Raman-induced Kerr effect microscopy as a new powerful coherent Raman imaging technique, combining background-free detection with the absence of non-resonant background and linear dependence on sample concentration.

articleTitle: Entanglement enhancement with cascaded nondegenerate optical parametric amplifier
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the cascaded entanglement enhancement of continuous variables. The quantum correlations are successively enhanced by two nondegenerate optical parametric amplifiers from -5.3 dB to -8.1 dB below quantum noise limit.

articleTitle: Femtosecond enhancement cavity EUV source with high energy resolution
abstract: A table-top EUV source based on a femtosecond enhancement cavity is seeded by a 1040-nm Yb-doped fiber amplifier system with 185-fs pulses and produces >;10 microwatts/harmonic at 80 MHz out to 55 nm.

articleTitle: Revealing nonlinear plasmon-photon interactions using k-space spectroscopy
abstract: We show how k-space spectroscopy distinguishes between the surface-plasmon (SP) and photon nonlinear interactions for SHG when metal films are excited in the Kretschmann-geometry, and confirm that two SP annihilate to create a second-harmonic photon.

articleTitle: In-vivo OCT imaging using wavelength swept fiber laser based on dispersion tuning
abstract: We are developing a widely wavelength-swept fiber laser based on dispersion tuning method for application to swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT) imaging. We successfully obtained the in-vivo OCT picture of the human skin.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped passively Q-switched Nd:YAG/BaWO4/KTP yellow laser
abstract: A diode-pumped passively Q-switched Nd:YAG/BaWO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/KTP yellow laser is presented for the first time. The obtained maximum average output power, conversion efficiency, pulse energy were 1.21 W, 9.06%, and 68.5 μJ, respectively.

articleTitle: Second order nonlinear frequency conversion processes in plasmonic slot waveguides
abstract: We study quadratic nonlinear interactions in plasmonic slot waveguides. Demonstrating modal phase matching, we exploit this feature toward parametric amplification of the plasmonic mode by means of a pump.

articleTitle: Wavelength-sized optomechanical disk resonator embedded in a sunflower circular photonic crystal
abstract: We demonstrate a micron-sized ultrahigh-Q (Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</inf>=740,000) disk cavity by embedding it in a sunflower-type circular photonic crystal. The disk's fundamental mechanical radial-contour mode is optically transduced at 2.19 GHz with a displacement sensitivity of 6.4 am/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>.

articleTitle: Cavity QED of NV centers with a tunable silica resonator
abstract: We report experimental studies, in which NV centers in a diamond nanopillar at 10 K are coupled to a high-Q silica microsphere whose resonance frequency can be tuned over a 500 GHz range.

articleTitle: Brillouin lasing in integrated liquid-core optical fibers
abstract: We report Brillouin lasing in an integrated liquid-core optical fiber (i-LCOF) filled with neat CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. This is the first observation of Brillouin lasing in the liquid state of matter, to the best of our knowledge. The linewidth of the single frequency liquid-based Brillouin laser was estimated to be <; 1kHz by beating two similar but independent lasers.

articleTitle: Quantum-enhanced optical vibrometer
abstract: System performance and design are presented for a quantum-enhanced vibrometer. The system uses a receiver with a phase-sensitive amplifier to provide ~0 dB NF amplification enabling <;3.2 dB SNR improvement throughout 20 kHz acoustic bandwidth.

articleTitle: Self-assembled plasmonic nanorings
abstract: Metallic nanoparticles are self-assembled into plasmonic nanorings using an evaporation-driven bottom-up approach. Well-ordered arrays of nanorings with controllable diameter and pitch are obtained on large areas. Their optical resonances are then characterized using extinction spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Femtosecond semiconductor laser emitting high average power 175-GHz pulse train
abstract: We describe a SESAM-mode-locked surface-emitting quantum well laser producing 400-fs pulses, with repetition frequency 175 GHz corresponding to the 117<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic of the external laser cavity, and average power 300 mW.

articleTitle: Highly efficient generation of single-cycle MV/cm THz pulses in organic crystals
abstract: We present the generation of high-power single-cycle THz pulses in organic salt crystals. Broadband THz radiation with MV/cm electric field strength is produced by optical rectification driven with a powerful femtosecond optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Divergence of high order harmonic emission from intense laser interactions with solid targets
abstract: Laser plasma interaction reveals harmonic divergence <;4 degrees and increasing with defocus. Circular polarization was found to cause a change in the angle of emission, which may be beneficial in efficient isolated attosecond pulse production.

articleTitle: Pulsed wavelength tuning and continuous wave operation of distributed Bragg reflector quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We demonstrated 37 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> pulsed wavelength tuning, and 500 mW CW output power at 20°C and 4.74 μm wavelength with a SMSR of 30 dB, using DBR QCLs unmounted and mounted epi-down, respectively.

articleTitle: Phase noise and dispersion in integrated silicon nitride based Kerr-comb generators
abstract: We report on measurements of phase noise dynamics of microwave beat notes observed in low repetition rate silicon nitride based Kerr-comb generators and relate them to results from dispersion simulations and measurements.

articleTitle: Assessment of helicopter brownout with a scanning lidar
abstract: There is very few quantitative data on Degraded Visual Environments (DVE) generated by the downwash of Rotary-Wing Platforms (RWP). In order to better understand the dynamics of DVE-RWP, we have used a scanning lidar to measure the cloud dimensions and optical depths generated by a helicopter hovering close to ground. It is shown that scanning lidar is a remarkable tool for quantifying DVE-RWP for low to moderate obscurations.

articleTitle: Plasmonic axicon micro-lenses for chemical sensing
abstract: We report on the fabrication of plasmonic hybrid sensors made of a micro-axicon dielectric lens and a single metallic nanoparticle. The dielectric lens produces a Bessel-like beam of light at its apex under plane wave excitation confining light in a narrow and intense beam with a low divergence. This Bessel-like beam can be used to optimize efficiently the excitation of a plasmonic nano-object and the collection of its far-field collected signal. This hybrid structure using the optical properties of a single metallic nanoparticle can act as a highly sensitive nanosensor.

articleTitle: Plasmonic metal nanoparticle enhanced thin film organic solar cells
abstract: A novel plasmonic enhanced OSCs with MNPs located at the interface of PEDOT:PSS anode layer and P3HT:PCBM active layer has been proposed and demonstrated theoretically and experimentally. The efficiency enhancement up to 25% is observed.

articleTitle: Characterization of gas phase temperatures in dependence of particle presence in the flame spray pyrolysis process
abstract: We introduce a novel strategy to acquire gas phase temperatures by O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> pure rotational CARS during flame spray pyrolysis (FSP) for silica production. RCARS benefits from a polarization filtering technique that is essential in particle and droplet environments. Particle containing regions were located by correlating laser-induced breakdown (LIB) in a particle-laden and a particle-free flame at different heights. Measured temperatures in the particle regime show significantly lower flame temperatures for particle-laden flames since energy is dissipated rapidly by radiation heat transfer in the presence of particles.

articleTitle: Stochastic spatiotemporal dynamics of stimulated Brillouin scattering in an optical fiber
abstract: We report transverse structure in the temporal dynamics of stimulated Brillouin scattering from single-mode pump pulses propagating through a two-mode fiber. Comparison of experiments and numerical simulations clarify the roles of thermal and pump fluctuations.

articleTitle: Ultra-low Vπ suspended quantum well waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub> L values in the optical L-band in suspended quantum well waveguides between 109 and 199 mV-cm, which result from the strong out-of-plane index contrast that tightly confines the mode to the quantum well core.

articleTitle: Improving soliton compression quality with cascaded nonlinearities by engineered multi-section quasi-phase-matching design
abstract: In few-cycle soliton generation with large compression factors using cascaded nonlinearities the pulse quality can be improved by engineering quasi-phase-matching structures. The soliton-induced mid-IR optical Cherenkov wave is also enhanced.

articleTitle: Label-free biosensors based on athermal silicon-on-insulator waveguides and a harmonic dithering technique
abstract: We report a new high-sensitivity biosensor using athermal TM-mode SOI resonators with bulk and surface detection limits of 4.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> RIU and ~100fg/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Simple DFB harmonic dithering feedback techniques obviate spectrometers and tunable lasers.

articleTitle: Spontaneous symmetry breaking of cavity polariton solitons due to pseudospin dynamics
abstract: We study the influence of the exciton pseudospin dynamics on the existence and stability of polariton solitons in a semiconductor microcavity. We find the spontaneous symmetry breaking of polarization and formation of vector polariton solitons.

articleTitle: Progress on the XG-III high-power laser facility with synchronized fs, ps and ns output pulses
abstract: The paper presents the technical design and progress on a high-power laser XG-III, which consists of three synchronized beams, i.e. the femtosecond, picosecond and nanosecond beams.

articleTitle: All fiber based supercontinuum light source utilized for IR microscopy
abstract: An all fiber based supercontinuum light source is demonstrated for infrared microscopy. The high brightness and spatial coherence of the source facilitate fast high resolution measurements.

articleTitle: Overcoming the temperature increase hurdle in photonic crystal molecular tweezers
abstract: We study the thermal effects on flow and transport of species near 1550nm silicon photonic crystal nano-tweezers. With a silicon nitride based 1064nm alternative we reduce heating to 0.3K temperature increase and demonstrate molecular tweezing.

articleTitle: Tapered gold helices as high-extinction-ratio, broadband circular polarizer
abstract: Tapering is shown to further extend the bandwidth of three-dimensional gold-helix metamaterials as broadband circular polarizers to about 1.5 octaves. Furthermore, the extinction ratio is improved. Theory and experiment show good agreement.

articleTitle: Optomechanics with ultracold atoms and SiN membranes
abstract: An optical lattice formed by reflection from a SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> membrane creates a bidirectional coupling of atomic and membrane motion. We measure the influence of the atoms on the membrane and explore causes of mechanical dissipation.

articleTitle: Conceptual study on planar-core optical fiber for high power fiber lasers
abstract: We present a new concept of planar-core optical fiber and show a fabricated planar-core fiber and a laser oscillation demonstration. The planar-core fiber will work as a medium of high power fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Control and mapping of x-ray emission in a laser-plasma accelerator
