abstract: We produce broadband frequency combs using degenerate sync-pumped OPO based on orientation-patterned GaAs pumped by an ultrafast laser. With a 2050-nm Tm-fiber femtosecond laser pump, the OPO instantaneous spectral span approaches 3-6 μm.

articleTitle: Measuring light's twist
abstract: Light carries an orbital angular momentum in addition to, and independent, of photon spin. Whereas the spin angular momentum (polarization) has only two orthogonal states, the orbital angular momentum has any number. To use this extra information we present a multi-way beam splitter to efficiently separate individual photons according to their orbital angular momentum.

articleTitle: A laser diode for integrated photon pair generation at telecom wavelength
abstract: We report on electrically pumped Bragg mode lasing at 775 nm at room temperature in an AlGaAs structure designed for type-II modal phase-matching showing a second harmonic generation efficiency of 35 %W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Coherent nonlinear spectroscopy with spatiotemporally controlled fields
abstract: Pulse shaping techniques combined with nanoplasmonics obtain spatiotemporal control of optical excitation in metal nanostructures. Using these methods we modify a coherent spectroscopy method to reveal new information about coupled nanosystems.

articleTitle: Terahertz molecular imaging for stem cells tracking
abstract: We present that the terahertz molecular imaging (TMI) technique can be applied to detection and movement of stem cells into the wound skin in vivo with employing nanoparticle probes.

articleTitle: Deep ultraviolet LED-based selective sensor for combustion gases
abstract: Novel III-Nitride based DUV-LEDs with peak emission wavelengths in the range of 225-230 were used to develop and demonstrate sensor for selective optical detection of NO in combustion gases.

articleTitle: High-energy, widely tunable, near- and mid-infrared picosecond optical parametric generator based on CdSiP2
abstract: We report a high-energy picosecond optical-parametric-generator tunable over 6153–6732 nm in the mid-infrared, 1264–1286 nm in near-infrared, providing ∼600 μJ of output energy over entire signal-tuning-range, >25μJ of idler energy over 55% of the idler-tuning-range.

articleTitle: Accelerating femtosecond pulses along highly non-paraxial circular trajectories
abstract: We report experimental acceleration of 100 fs pulses along 60° arc circular trajectories, the highest degree of beam acceleration reported to date. We show that temporal pulse shape is preserved along the main intensity lobe.

articleTitle: Detailed performance analysis of the proposed QEYSSAT quantum receiver satellite
abstract: Transmission losses limit quantum key distribution (QKD) to distances of only a few hundred kilometres. We investigate performance aspects of the QEYSSAT proposal to demonstrate global QKD using a microsatellite as a trusted quantum receiver.

articleTitle: Effect of the birefringent beat length on variability in passively modelocked fiber lasers
abstract: Birefringence leads to sensitivity of the power transfer to polarization controller settings in passively modelocked fiber lasers that use nonlinear polarization rotation for fast saturable absorption. Shorter beat lengths lead to easier modelocking.

articleTitle: A tunable microcavity
abstract: We present a miniaturized Fabry-Pérot microcavity for cavity experiments on optically active nanostructures. Spectral and spatial tuning of the Purcell effect (weak coupling regime) on a single InGaAs quantum dot is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Large-scale plasmonic microarray: A new approach for label-free high-throughput biosensing and screening
abstract: We present a large-scale label-free microarray with over one million plasmonic nanohole array sensors on a microscope slide. A dual-color filter imaging method is invented to dramatically increase the sensor performance in a highly-multiplexed manner.

articleTitle: First MIXSEL with a quantum well saturable absorber: Shorter pulse durations and higher repetition rates
abstract: We present the first Modelocked Integrated eXternal-Cavity Surface Emitting Laser (MIXSEL) based on a quantum well absorber, achieving 4.8-ps pulses at a repetition rate of 2.9 GHz and 6.8-ps pulses at 20.8 GHz.

articleTitle: A composite cavity QED system deepening the strong coupling regime
abstract: We propose a composite cavity quantum electrodynamics system in which the resonant structure consists of a metal nanoparticle and a whispering-gallery microcavity. The system enables more than 100-fold enhancement of the cooperativity parameter.

articleTitle: Correlations and collisions in air laser emission for atmospheric remote sensing
abstract: We measure strong correlations between the forward and backward emitted pulses from the atomic oxygen laser. We show that the laser spikes are correlated with the pump and do not depend on the collisional frequency.

articleTitle: Optical collisions in a metastable neon MOT
abstract: We present results for controlled optical collisions of cold neon atoms in the (3s)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> metastable state trapped in a magneto-optical trap (MOT).

articleTitle: Fano-resonant asymmetric metamaterials for sensing and vibrational fingerprinting of protein monolayers
abstract: Precise information about the structure of protein monolayers (thickness, bond orientation, dipole strength) can be obtained using difference-reflectivity spectroscopy of functionalized Fano-resonant asymmetric metamaterials. Experimental results for peptide, single-protein, and two-protein monolayers will be presented.

articleTitle: High-speed molecular spectral imaging by stimulated Raman scattering microscopy using wavelength-tunable pulses
abstract: A 15-frame/s stimulated Raman microscope with frame-by-frame wavelength tunability has been developed. Fast spectral imaging of polymer beads in the CH stretching region with a bandwidth of 250 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is accomplished in 2.6 seconds.

articleTitle: Large area Sagnac interferometer based on laser-cooled atoms
abstract: We present a high resolution atom interferometer gyroscope based on stimulated Raman transitions of neutral atoms. Employing three separate interaction zones allows to enlarge the signal while maintaining high compactness.

articleTitle: Tutorial on solar energy
abstract: Summary form only given. The solar industry has grown at an astonishingly high rate over the past decade. This growth has been both in what one could consider the “traditional” areas such as flat panel crystalline silicon arrays, as well as in “new” technologies such as thin film CdTe arrays on glass. We will review some of the major discoveries of the past and trace how the industry came to be where it is today. We will also provide an overview of some of the latest discoveries in the field and what are the current hot areas of interest. Finally, we will discuss what these current trends industry may hold for the future, both technically and from a business perspective for this very rapidly developing field.

articleTitle: Intense terahertz pulse-induced nonequilibrium BCS state in superconducting NbN
abstract: We perform terahertz(THz)-pump-THz-probe spectroscopy to study ultrafast dynamics of BCS superconductor NbN. Resonant photo-injection of high density quasiparticles realized by the intense THz pump pulses results in a nonequilibrium BCS state.

articleTitle: Fabrication of microlens arrays in polycarbonate with nanojoule energy femtosecond laser pulses
abstract: Microlens arrays were fabricated by focusing a high repetition rate femtosecond laser with low energy pulses inside polycarbonate samples. The microlens was imaged in a scanning electron microscope and was optically characterized using a HeNe laser. It was found that the microlens has a diameter of 80 μm, a focal length of 100 μm, a numerical apperture of 0.63 and a spot diameter of 1.2 μm. Additionally, we found that a void is created under the microlens.

articleTitle: Generation of high-fidelity few-cycle pulses at 2 μm via XPW
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of spectrally clean few-cycle pulses at 2.1 μm by shortening of 40 fs pulses via cross-polarized wave (XPW) generation. Single-shot autocorrelation traces show 20 fs pulse duration.

articleTitle: Dual beam operation of the Astra-Gemini high power laser and upgrades to the Ti:Sapphire amplifiers
abstract: Special considerations of operating the dual beam facility Gemini are presented. Amplifiers in Astra have been upgraded to improve the contrast, stability and performance with wedged Ti:Sapphire crystals and spatial filtering.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse spectral synthesis using coherently combined multi-channel fiber chirped pulse amplifiers
abstract: We synthesize femtosecond pulses by coherently combining spectra from three fiber chirped pulse amplifiers. Multi-channel spectral synthesis offers a way to overcome gain narrowing limitations in a single fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Angle selective transparent photovoltaics using anodized alumina
abstract: Nanoporous alumina back reflector shows angle selective scattering which can overcome the transparency vs. photocurrent-generation tradeoff in transparent photovoltaics. 35% backscattering is obtained at 45-degree incidence increasing the photocurrent while maintaining high transparency parallel to ground.

articleTitle: Non-perturbative four-wave mixing in bulk InSb driven by intense off-resonant THz pulses
abstract: A high-field multi-THz source is used to study the nonlinear response of InSb under off-resonant excitation. Field-resolved four-wave mixing signals demonstrate clear signatures of a non-perturbative regime in agreement with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Progress of the 171Yb optical lattice clock at NMIJ, AIST
abstract: Experimental efforts to reduce the uncertainty of the ytterbium (<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">171</sup>Yb) optical lattice clock at NMIJ, AIST are shown. The signal-to-noise ratio of the spectrum was increased by 10 times by an atom number normalization scheme.

articleTitle: Generation of pseudo-radially-polarized beams in a diode-pumped solid-state laser
abstract: A simple technique for directly generating pseudo-radially-polarized or pseudo azimuthally-polarized donut-shaped beams in a diode-pumped solid-state laser is presented. Preliminary results for a Nd:YAG laser are described and the further potential of this technique is considered.

articleTitle: Intracavity terahertz generation in laser output coupler made from stacked GaP plates
abstract: Efficient terahertz pulses are emitted from stacked GaP plates used as an output coupler for a Q-switched solid-state laser. Such a novel intracavity configuration is exploited to achieve an enhancement of two orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal defect cavity Q-factor optimization using slab thickness
abstract: Three mechanisms are studied which give rise to a high-Q L3 cavity mode in a 2D photonic crystal slab where the in-plane photonic bandgap is closed due to increased slab thickness.

articleTitle: Time resolved separation and recombination of carrier distributions in graphene
abstract: Employing the technique of time-resolved photoemission allowed the measurement of carrier distributions in graphene. An initial separation followed by an eventual coalescence of the distributions was directly observed for the first time.

articleTitle: Sub 100-fs pulse compression in a Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber (HC-PCF)
abstract: We spectrally broaden 860 fs pulses from a 5.1-W, 3.9-MHz thin disk laser in a 3.15 m long Xe-filled HC-PCF. After compression, we achieve 3.1-W in sub 100-fs pulses at a peak power exceeding 5 MW.

articleTitle: Field-free asymmetric top alignment and rotational revivals using high harmonic generation
abstract: Using high harmonic generation (HHG), we probe the nonadiabatic revival structure in the asymmetric top sulfur dioxide. We find that HHG is sensitive to molecular alignment about different axes as well as of partial revivals.

articleTitle: Widely tunable large area SBRs for ultra-short pulse generation
abstract: Fabrication and characterization of ultra-broadband high index contrast III/V-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub> Saturable Bragg Reflectors as mesas as well as inverted mesa structures for ultra-short pulse generation is presented along with a physical model of the oxidation process.

articleTitle: Control over two-dimensional vibrational trajectory by phase-shaped infrared pulses
abstract: We demonstrate that relative phase between two vibrational excitations in a metal di-carbonyl compound was controlled by phase-shaped mid-infrared pulses. The control over the relative phase between two normal modes of symmetric and anti-symmetric carbonyl stretch modes corresponds to control over two-dimensional vibrational trajectory at the initial stage after excitation.

articleTitle: Coupled-resonator optical waveguides (CROWs) based on tapered grating-defect resonators
abstract: We report experimental results of CROWs based on high-Q (Q~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) tapered grating-defect resonators in silicon waveguides. CROWs with 36 resonators and tailored coupling coefficients are demonstrated, showing group velocities of c/11.2 and c/23.6.

articleTitle: One to eight multicasting of RZ-DPSK based on cascaded FOPA without additional SBS suppression
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate one-to-eight all-optical wavelength multicasting for 10.7-Gbit/s RZ-DPSK based on dual-pump four-wave-mixing in a generally highly nonlinear fiber. No additional stimulated Brillouin scattering suppression scheme is required in the experiment.

articleTitle: Demonstration of modulation instability assisted by a periodic dispersion landscape in an optical fiber
abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally the MI process in a dispersion oscillating fiber. An important number of unstable frequencies are generated that then lead to a new degree of freedom for tailoring nonlinear effects.

articleTitle: Delocalization enhancement induced by weak disorder and nonlinearity
abstract: We show theoretically and experimentally for planar and square lattices, that during the initial diffractive broadening of a narrow excitation, small amounts of disorder may enhance delocalization. This effect is amplified by nonlinear propagation.

articleTitle: Single-frequency passively Q-switched Er:YAG laser
abstract: Passive Q-Switching of Er-fiber-Er:YAG hybrid laser was realized by Cr:ZnSe saturable absorber. Single- and multi-modes regimes of operation were analyzed experimentally and theoretically. Preliminary theoretical prediction is in a satisfactory agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Microcavity Brillouin laser with high coherence
abstract: The first chip-based stimulated Brillouin laser (SBL) is demonstrated. It has efficiency of 90% and exhibits record coherence for an on-chip device, featuring Schawlow-Townes frequency noise of 60 milliHz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Hz. Low technical noise is also observed.

articleTitle: Synchrotron microspectroscopy of quantum cascade laser devices based on quantum wells and quantum dashes
abstract: We apply synchrotron-based Infrared broadband (0.08-1eV) transmission measurements of quantum cascade laser devices based on quantum wells and quantum dashes to determine qualitative and quantitative intersubband gain and waveguide losses.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the geometric spin Hall effect of light in highly focused vector beams
abstract: We demonstrate the geometric spin Hall effect of light by focusing a specially polarization tailored beam of light, resulting in the generation of purely transverse angular momentum in the focal plane.

articleTitle: High power Q-switched fiber laser system emitting 26 mJ pulses with near diffraction-limited beam quality
abstract: We demonstrate a high-power Q-switched fiber laser system emitting 26 mJ pulse energy with sub 60 ns pulses. In combination with a repetition rate of 5 kHz an average power of more than 140 W was achieved. These results were enabled by a Large-Pitch fiber, which allows effective single-mode operation with high beam quality (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> <; 13) and mode field diameters exceeding 100 μm.

articleTitle: Bistable switching and gain recovery dynamics in hybrid III-V/SOI nanolasers
abstract: We report on optical bistability based on injection locking of hybrid III-V/Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI) nanolaser. Switching power is measured below 40μW. 30ps switching time is deduced from gain recovery time measurement.

articleTitle: Elliptical nanowire bifocal lenses
abstract: Nano-structured lenses are designed to capture two different images of a scene depending on the polarization of the illumination. The polarization dependence is based on form birefringence found in elliptical cross-section silicon nanowires.

articleTitle: Collective effects in second-harmonic generation from split-ring-resonator arrays
abstract: We perform experiments on resonant second-harmonic generation from planar gold split-ring-resonator arrays under normal incidence of light as a function of the lattice constant. Optimum nonlinear conversion occurs at intermediate lattice constants.

articleTitle: 257 MHz pulse repetition rate from a modelocked VECSEL
abstract: With a multi-pass cavity we avoid modelocking instabilities of low-repetition rate VECSELs due to short gain lifetime. We achieve a record-low repetition rate of 257 MHz which we could not realize with the conventional cavity.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser fabrication of low-loss waveguides in chalcogenide glass with 0.65 dB/cm loss
abstract: We present 0.65-dB/cm loss symmetric waveguides fabricated in Gallium Lanthanum Sulfide glasses using spatial and temporal shaped ultrafast laser pulses. Micro-Raman analysis was used to correlate optical loss versus laser-induced lattice damages.

articleTitle: 1.55 μm high-speed quantum dot lasers for telecommunication applications
abstract: We present room temperature characteristics of 340μm long 1.55μm quantum dot lasers. Due to the high modal gain of 10cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> per dot layer, CW ground state lasing and record modulation rates of 15Gbit/sec were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of surface plasmon properties on different metals using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
abstract: We directly measure the dielectric properties of different metals relevant to plasmonics using a modified THz time-domain spectroscopy approach. The computed permittivity values differ significantly from published data, but agree well with other measured parameters.

articleTitle: Single pulse multiphoton fabrication of photopolymerized periodic structures using vortex beams
abstract: Single ultra-short pulses with a vortex phase profile have been used to fabricate periodically modulated hollow cylinders via multi-photon polymerization. Fabrication and spectral characterization of these objects are presented.

articleTitle: Parabolic tapered photonic crystal cavity in silicon
abstract: We demonstrate the design, fabrication, transmission and nearfield characterization of a novel parabolic tapered 1D photonic crystal cavity in silicon. The design allows repeatable device fabrication, high quality factor and small modal volume.

articleTitle: Improved performance of optical beam steering through an InP photonic integrated circuit
abstract: Optical beam steering through an InP photonic integrated circuit has been improved in term of side-lobe suppression (13dB from -14° to 14° around the peak) and steering angle (10° by 28nm wavelength tuning).

articleTitle: Multipolar and unidirectional emission of quantum emitters coupled to optical antennas
abstract: Nanoscale single-photon emitters behave generally as dipoles. Here, we demonstrate multipolar and unidirectional emission of a quantum dot by near-field coupling to optical nanowire and Yagi-Uda antennas, that determine its angular radiation pattern and polarization.

articleTitle: Static rerouting of light via tip-induced nano-oxidation in silicon interconnect components
abstract: Tip-induced oxidation of silicon waveguides is used to re-route light path through typical 2×2 circuits such as microrings and Mach-Zehnder interferometers used in silicon interconnects.

articleTitle: Sub-surface terahertz imaging through uneven surfaces: Visualizing Neolithic wall paintings in Çatalhöyük
abstract: Portions of Neolithic paintings at Çatalhöyük, Turkey, are hidden under uneven covering layers of plaster. Traditional terahertz data analysis has proven unsuccessful at subsurface imaging of these paintings. An imaging technique is presented, based around Gaussian beam-mode coupling, to visualize the obscured painting.

articleTitle: Over 25W nanosecond vortex laser based on a stressed Yb-doped fiber power amplifier
abstract: 26.5W of nanosecond vortex laser based on a stressed Yb-doped fiber amplifier was demonstrated. The peak power of 70 kW was obtained, corresponding to optical-optical efficiency of 41 %.

articleTitle: Demonstration of quasi-cylindrical wave contribution in experiments on the extraordinary optical transmission
abstract: We compare the transmission spectra of metal hole arrays with different hole densities. The scaled transmission is relatively constant as a function of increasing density, up to the largest density, where a sudden increase of the transmission is found.

articleTitle: Distributed birefringence measurement of a 500-m polarization-maintaining fiber with a 20-cm resolution based on Brillouin dynamic grating
abstract: We propose a novel scheme to realize distributed birefringence measurement over a 500-m polarization-maintaining fiber with a 20-cm resolution based on Brillouin dynamic grating, observing three characteristic periods of the birefringence variation.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency laser Doppler velocimeter for speckle noise reduction
abstract: We develop a dual-frequency laser Doppler velocimeter based on an optically-injected semiconductor laser. Spectral broadening suffered from the speckle noise is much suppressed benefitted by the longer effective wavelength.

articleTitle: Large dispersion of silicon waveguide directional couplers
abstract: We demonstrate that the magnitude of the wavelength variation (dispersion) of waveguide directional couplers considerably exceeds the modal refractive index dispersion of typical single-mode silicon nanophotonic waveguides, and investigate approaches to achieve wavelength-flattened filtering response.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical study of Ag nanoparticles-Si quantum dots plasmonic nanostructured system
abstract: We studied an integrated silver and silicon nanostructured system, which shows a nonlinear optical response changing its sign with wavelength, depending on its position with respect to the surface plasmon resonance of the nanocomposite.

articleTitle: Compensating the loss in the plasmonic waveguides and feasibility of sub-wavelength plasmonic lasers
abstract: We show that full compensation of loss in plasmonic waveguides with significantly sub-wavelength light confinement (less than λ/4n) requires current density in excess of 100 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> making sub-wavelength in all three dimensions laser (spaser) impractical.

articleTitle: Watt-level fluoride glass Raman fiber laser
abstract: We report on the first watt-level fluoride glass Raman fiber laser. A maximum output power of 1.22 W at the first Stokes order wavelength of 2231.4 nm was produced out of a nested cavity Raman fiber laser.

articleTitle: Stochastic bistable switching in CMOS-processed PECVD silicon nitride ring resonators
abstract: Absorptive optical nonlinearity is demonstrated in silicon nitride rings with ~244,000 intrinsic quality factors. Thermal induced optical nonlinearity leads to stochastic bistable switching in the absence of free carrier dispersion, towards CMOS-compatible photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Generation of optical rogue waves by optical event horizons
abstract: We demonstrate that optical event horizons arise naturally in the supercontinuum generation by soliton fission with the ability to generate rare solitons with extreme high peak powers.

articleTitle: Self-induced thermal nonlinearities in InGaAsP microtubes at telecom wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, dynamical thermal effects in InGaAsP microtubes at telecom wavelengths. Such effect can be avoided or exploited for passive or active applications by choosing appropriate resonance wavelengths.

articleTitle: A nanoporous optofluidic SERS microsystem for sensitive and repeatable on-site detection of melamine
abstract: We report a surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy device with on-chip mixing, integrated fiber optics, and nanofluidic concentration of Ag nanoclusters and adsorbed analytes. The device's detection limit is 100X better than open-channel microfluidics.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional absorption enhancement in hybrid waveguide-plasmon system
abstract: Omnidirectional absorption enhancements induced by localized surface plasmon resonances supported by gold nanowire arrays embedded in a slab waveguide are demonstrated, which could find applications on novel photovoltaic devices or photodetectors.

articleTitle: Optical spin-injection of a 1300nm-VCSEL
abstract: We report the first room temperature optical spin-injection of a dilute nitride 1300 nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser under continuous wave pumping. Very good agreement is found with theoretical predictions obtained with the spin flip model.

articleTitle: Transparent conductive oxides for effective low-refractive-index Ohmic contact to nanophotonic devices demonstrated with Fabry-Perot lasers
abstract: We show the possibility of using transparent conductive oxide (TCO) for the current injection into nanophotonic devices. An InP based coplanar electrode Fabry-Perot micro-laser utilizing indium oxide (In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) as the n-type cladding electrode is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Anomalous optical forces on a Mie-particle in a transverse Poynting vector flow
abstract: We show how a superposition of non-interfering plane waves can generate a transverse Poynting vector, which in turn leads to transverse optical forces on a fully isotropic dielectric scatterer, in contrast with conventional radiation-pressure forces.

articleTitle: 260 nm pseudomorphic ultraviolet light emitting diodes with enhanced photon extraction efficiency
abstract: We designed and fabricated 260 nm ultraviolet LEDs which demonstrated 20mW with greater than 1.5% WPE. Through surface roughening, substrate thinning and encapsulation, a 6× improvement in photon extraction efficiency has been achieved.

articleTitle: Opto-thermophoretic trapping of microparticles in air-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
abstract: Dielectric microparticles optically propelled along an air-filled hollow-core PCF come to a halt just before an absorbing mark on the fiber coating, when radiation pressure is opposed by an equal and opposite thermophoretic force.

articleTitle: Quantum-coherent coupling of a mechanical oscillator to an optical cavity mode
abstract: We demonstrate an optomechanical microresonator in which optical and mechanical degrees of freedom exchange energy at a rate exceeding the relevant decoherence rates in the system, enabling quantum control of a mechanical oscillator with light.

articleTitle: Phase-locking and coherent power combining of linearly chirped optical waves
abstract: Rapidly chirped optical waveforms reduce stimulated Brillouin scattering in fiber amplifiers, enabling higher output powers. This work demonstrates homodyne and heterodyne phase-locking, and coherent combining, of linearly chirped optical waves using acoustooptic frequency shifters.

articleTitle: Generating phonon pairs with cavity optomechanics
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of classically correlated phonon pairs, for which two mechanical modes in a silica microsphere are coupled to a common optical mode via optomechanical parametric amplification and state-transfer processes, respectively.

articleTitle: Generation of ultrashort optical vortex pulses using optical parametric amplification
abstract: The generation of 2.3-cycle, 5.9-fs, 56-μJ ultrashort optical-vortex pulses by optical parametric amplification was performed. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first generation of optical vortex pulses in the few-cycle regime.

articleTitle: Slow light over 1,000 fractional pulses based on ultrahigh-order guided modes in symmetrical metal-cladding optical waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate 1,400 fractional delay of sub-ps pulses based on ultrahigh-order guided modes in symmetrical metal-cladding optical waveguide. DBP value of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> is obtained by material dispersion independent and wide bandwidth operation.

articleTitle: Milliwatt-level power generated in the sub-terahertz range by photomixing in a metal-metal resonant cavity GaAs photoconductor
abstract: It is shown from on-wafer measurement that a continuous wave output power of 0.35 mW at 305 GHz can be generated by photomixing in a metal-metal Fabry-Pérot GaAs photoconductor.

articleTitle: Broad spectral range synchronized flat-top arrayed waveguide grating
abstract: A broad-band Mach-Zehnder-interferometer-synchronized flat-top arrayed waveguide grating is presented with a 0.5-dB bandwidth of 12 nm over 90 nm of spectral range and a central excess loss value of -0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Raman-free Soliton Self-Frequency-Shift in Photonic Crystal waveguides
abstract: Cherenkov radiation and Soliton Self Frequency Shift are reported in (1.5mm-long) Photonic Crystal waveguides. The picosecond and picojoule pulses used here and the absence of Raman-induced frequency shift are peculiar of this new nonlinear material.

articleTitle: Minimizing quenching of plasmonic sensors caused by adhesion layers
abstract: Adhesion layers necessary for the robustness of plasmonic sensors are commonly used at dimensions where the electric near-field intensity can be strongly quenched. We have found that by minimizing the layer thickness to roughly 0.5 nm and by additionally controlling the geometric design of the layer, quenching can by reduced by a factor of up to 7.

articleTitle: Strongly confined hybrid plasmonic modes guided by nanowire-embedded-metal grooves for low-loss propagation
abstract: An easy-to-fabricate hybrid plasmonic waveguide consisting of a semiconductor nanowire embedded inside a dielectric-coated V-shaped metal groove is shown to support strongly confined hybrid plasmonic modes avoiding alignment errors.

articleTitle: A broadband 1850-nm 40-Gb/s receiver based on four-wave mixing in silicon waveguides
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a FWM-based receiver operating at long wavelengths. The scheme successfully demultiplexes a 1866-nm 40-Gb/s NRZ signal into 10-Gb/s tributaries while simultaneously wavelength-converting it to 1320 nm for photodetection.

articleTitle: Manipulating terahertz beams using inhomogeneous artificial dielectrics
abstract: Using waveguide-based inhomogeneous artificial dielectrics, we engineer the path of a terahertz beam to loop around an object situated inline with the input optic axis, effectively rendering the object invisible to the beam.

articleTitle: Nonlinear matching of solitons — Continued redshift between silica and soft-glass fibers
abstract: We present an analysis of nonlinear coupling between fibers. We introduce the nonlinear coupling coefficient and investigate solitons coupling from one fiber into another. We will also present simulated supercontinuum from concatenated fiber systems.

articleTitle: Fiber optical parametric frequency conversion: Alignment and maintenance free all-fiber laser concept for CARS microscopy
abstract: We present the development and experimental demonstration of a parametric all-fiber laser source for CARS microscopy. Since the pump and Stokes wavelengths are generated by four-wave-mixing, both pulses are emitted from a single fiber end with intrinsic synchronization. The generated wavelength pair around 780 nm and 1030 nm was used to probe the aromatic CH-stretch vibrational resonance of toluene at 3050 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Reproduction of the CARS resonance bandshape by spectral tuning as well as microscopic imaging within the aromatic CH-stretching region demonstrates the CARS capabilities of the laser.

articleTitle: Conditional quantum teleportation of non-Gaussian states of light: Improvement to output state non-classicality
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate conditional teleportation of non-Gaussian nonclassical states of light. The nonclassicality of the Wigner function is proven to be enhanced: the negativity is stronger than what deterministic operations achieve.

articleTitle: Design of a “shape-optimized” electromagnetic absorber with maximized heat transfer to the surrounding
abstract: We present a novel design to increase the photo-thermal conversion efficiency of metallic nanostructures by utilizing their shape dependency of the electromagnetic absorption and the transfer of thermal energy to the surrounding medium.

articleTitle: An active feedback pulse shaping technique with spectral phase and intensity modulation to generate transform limited, parabolic pulses for CPA systems
abstract: A first demonstration of fiber based CPA system with an active feedback loop utilizing spectral phase and intensity modulation to generate clean, high contrast, 10 dB pedestals suppression, transform limited pulse with parabolic intensity profile.

articleTitle: Watt-level, tunable, fiber-laser-pumped picosecond parametric source for the near-infrared
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable picosecond source providing up to 3.5 W over 752-860 nm, with a power stability of 1.6% rms over 14 hours using intracavity frequency-doubling in optical-parametric-oscillator synchronously pumped by a Yb-fiber laser.

articleTitle: Subwavelength plasmonic directional couplers for nonlinear switching and wavelength division
abstract: Plasmonic gap waveguides allow for subwavelength integration of optical circuitry. A side effect is extraordinarily high field enhancement. Here we present experimental and numeric results, which indicate nonlinear switching in a directional coupler.

articleTitle: Ultrasensitive immunosensor based on Electrogenerated chemiluminescence quenching of CdS/TiO2 nanotube arrays for detection of antigen
abstract: An ultrasensitve antigen detection platform based on CdS nanocrystals decorated TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanotube arrays can be achieved using an efficient Electrogenerated chemiluminescence quenching process introduced by sandwiched immunoreaction.

articleTitle: Barium nitrate Raman laser for CO2 detection
abstract: Frequency conversion of a single longitudinal mode Nd:YAG laser operating at 1.064 μm is realized by an external third order Stokes barium nitrate Raman laser providing narrowband radiation at 1.599 μm applied for CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> detection.

articleTitle: Telecom-wavelength photon number resolving detectors based on the series array of superconducting nanowires
abstract: We present a novel photon number resolving detector based on the series array of superconducting nanowires, each shunted by an integrated resistor. The device can successfully discriminate between 1-4 absorbed photons in telecom-wavelength optical pulses.

articleTitle: Optical adiabatic spin transfer in diamond nitrogen vacancy centers
abstract: We develop control and measurement techniques for adiabatic population transfer of electron spins associated with nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond.

articleTitle: Towards quantum frequency conversion via non-degenerate four-wave mixing in nanophotonic waveguides
abstract: Low-noise wavelength conversion through non-degenerate four-wave-mixing Bragg scattering in SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> waveguides is demonstrated. Two 1550 nm pumps are used to achieve tunable conversion of a 980 nm signal over a range of 10 nm.

articleTitle: Monolithic white LED with controllable color temperature
abstract: We have developed monolithic white light emitting diodes (LEDs), which consist of planar planes and nano size hexagonal pyramids structure. The white spectrum is achieved by blue and yellow emissions from the InGaN multi quantum wells (MQWs) on the planar c-planes and on the nano-pyramids, respectively. The color temperature is tuned from 3600K to 6400K by controlling the relative area ratio of c-plane and nano-pyramids.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional spherical signal constellation for few-mode fiber based high-speed optical transmission
abstract: We propose the optimized three-dimensional spherical signal constellations (3D-SSCs), suitable for use in few-mode fiber-optic communications. The proposed signal constellations are based on the optimum distributions, which are determined by the split-step method. The numerical results show that the 3D-SSCs outperform the previously proposed constellations and improve the optical signal-to-noise ratio sensitivity by up to 3.89dB at bit error ratio of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>.

articleTitle: Switchable aperiodic distributed feedback lasers: Time domain modelling and experiment
abstract: We present a perturbative aperiodic distributed feedback grating embedded within a Fabry-Pérot cavity. Time domain modelling revealed electronic switching functionality, occurring only in the presence of facet reflections. The switching behaviour was experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Cryogenic faraday isolator for multikilowatt average laser power
abstract: Design of cryogenic Faraday isolator for multikilowatt laser power is described. Characteristics of device have been investigated experimentally at laser power above 1 kW and possibility of its use at power 6 kW is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Intense attosecond pulse trains from relativistic surface plasmas
abstract: We report on the unequal spacing attosecond pulse trains from relativistic surface plasmas. The surface high harmonics efficiency is determined and could be enhanced using an optimized plasma scale length and density.

articleTitle: Mid-IR broadband quantum cascade laser frequency-comb
abstract: We show a free-running broadband QCL emitting a frequency-comb of 490 nm at 7μm whose spectral phase signature resembles to the one of a frequency-modulate laser. Beatnote-linewidths as narrow as f <; 10Hz are measured.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in aluminum nitride waveguides on silicon substrates
abstract: Second harmonic generation is demonstrated in aluminum nitride (AlN) ridge waveguides on silicon substrates pumped by continuous wave telecom wavelength light. Phase matching is achieved by engineering waveguide modal dispersion.

articleTitle: Phase drift cancellation for long-term transfer using electronic compensation loop
abstract: We report a long-term stable frequency transfer experiment over a 20 km fiber link using an electronic compensation scheme. The data show that the phase drift was reduced from 1.59 ns to 6.3 ps.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgap plasmonic waveguides
abstract: A novel type of plasmonic waveguides is proposed featuring an “open” design with convenient access to a plasmonic mode. Its optical properties are investigated experimentally and numerically confirming PBG guidance in a broad spectral range.

articleTitle: 120 dB. Hz2/3 spur free dynamic range from a resonant cavity interferometric linear intensity modulator
abstract: A 120 dB. Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup> spur free dynamic range (SFDR) is achieved directly from a resonant cavity interferometric linear intensity modulator. Also, the dependence of the SFDR of this modulator on the bias point is studied.

articleTitle: Compact multi-pass cell based Faraday rotation spectrometer for nitric oxide detection
abstract: Nitric oxide sensing based on a 3.5 m Herriott cell-enhanced Faraday rotation spectrometer is reported. A minimum detection limit of 3.2 ppb/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> is achieved using NO R(8.5)e transition at 1906.14cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and 100 Gauss field.

articleTitle: Terahertz wave control enabled by nano objects embedded in slot antennas
abstract: We show that sub-skin depth nano metallic objects embedded in terahertz slot antennas strongly modulate their resonance features. Our findings have fundamental implications for sensitive nanoparticle detections using millimeter wavelength light.

articleTitle: On-chip, tunable, narrow-bandpass microwave photonic filter using stimulated brillouin scattering (SBS)
abstract: We report the first demonstration of a narrow-bandpass (~20MHz), on-chip, tunable, photonic filter for RF signals, using SBS in a chalcogenide waveguide. Extinction ratios of over 20dB for a frequency range of 2-12GHz were realized.

articleTitle: Self-locked low threshold OPO in a CMOS-compatible microring resonator
abstract: We report a novel design for an integrated optical parametric oscillator (OPO) in a CMOS-compatible microring. It exploits self-sustained lasing of the pump tuned to a microcavity resonance, preventing the OPO from dimming with thermal fluctuations.

articleTitle: An all-optical resonator stabilization scheme with laser machined SiO2 microresonators
abstract: We present a novel fabrication method for ultra-high-Q fused silica microresonators using CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser machining. These resonators are used to investigate an all-optical stabilization scheme of their mode spectrum with a frequency doubled control laser.

articleTitle: Single shot two dimensional spectroscopy of photo-bleachable molecules
abstract: Vibrational spectra of highly photo-bleachable molecules are measured, and ground-and excited-state dynamics is observed by single shot four wave mixing enabled using a novel geometrical mapping of the delay times in the beams.

articleTitle: Giant resonance and absorption in ultrathin metamaterial
abstract: We study a metamaterial periodic structure consisting of alternating positive/negative refractive index layers. Very narrow resonance peaks with absorption of 50% are obtained, for a structure thickness as thin as 1% of the incident wavelength.

articleTitle: 2D Nd:MgO:PPLN for simultaneous laser generation, Q-switching, and optical parametric oscillation
abstract: We report a tunable, internal-Q-switched self-frequency-conversion laser based on a 2D Nd:MgO:PPLN integrating device functionalities of laser and optical-parametric gain media and an EO Q-switch. >;350-W eye-safe light was obtained with this system.

articleTitle: Spectral mirror imaging in ultrafast optical parametric processes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and theoretically explore a spectral imaging system where two spectral sidebands produced through an optical parametric process always have reversed spectral profiles with respect to the center frequency of the pump.

articleTitle: Tabletop reflection mode coherent diffractive imaging of periodic nano-structures with 100 nm resolution
abstract: We report the first reflection-mode coherent diffraction imaging using a tabletop short wavelength light source. A novel imaging scheme can probe metalic nano-pillar arrays with ~100 nm resolution.

articleTitle: Engineered reflectance and transmittance in curvilinear hyperbolic metamaterials and hyperbolic metamaterials with scatterers
abstract: We have demonstrated the reduction of reflectance in curvilinear lamellar hyperbolic metamaterials and hyperbolic metamaterials with deposited TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> scatterers. The effect is accompanied by an enhancement of the sample's transmission and its non-reciprocity.

articleTitle: Channel waveguide lasers produced by femtosecond and picosecond direct laser writing in Ti:Sapphire crystals
abstract: Femtosecond-laser-written Ti:sapphire channel waveguides laser at ~798.25 nm above a threshold pump power of 84 mW with output power and slope efficiency of 143 mW and 23.5%, respectively. Lasing was also observed in picosecond-laser-written channels.

articleTitle: Giant enhancement of stimulated Brillouin scattering in the sub-wavelength limit
abstract: We show that the nature of stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) radically changes at nanoscales due to tremendous internal radiation pressures. Coherent interplay between radiation pressure and electrostriction yields giant enhancement of SBS and tailorable photon-phonon coupling.

articleTitle: Rapid scan mode with THz OSCAT spectrometer
abstract: We present OSCAT laser systems as a general tool for pump and probe experiments. The current development offers unlimited temporal scanning range using the intracavity motor and a rapid scan mode with a range of 100 ps.

articleTitle: In-fiber fabrication of size-controllable structured particles
abstract: We present an approach for fabricating single-material and multi-material structured spherical particles in the size range 1 millimeter to 50 nanometers that makes use of the Plateau-Rayleigh capillary instability in a multi-material fiber.

articleTitle: All optical control of optomechanical filters
abstract: We demonstrate optical reconfiguration of coupled photonic crystal nanobeam cavities by using optical gradient force. The on-chip temperature sensing scheme along with pulsed operation allows us to estimate and control thermal and optomechanical effects.

articleTitle: An all-silicon passive optical diode
abstract: We demonstrate an optical diode with up to 28dB transmission contrast at telecommunication wavelengths. It is based on strong optical nonlinearity in two resonance-matched silicon microrings. No external assistance other than input light is required.

articleTitle: Ultrafast direct modulation of a single-mode photonic crystal nanocavity light-emitting diode
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically driven single mode photonic crystal cavity LED with record speed of operation (10 GHz) and 0.25 fJ/bit energy consumption, the lowest of any optical transmitter to date.

articleTitle: Creating strong single molecule emitter using 3-dimensional plasmonic nano-cavity
abstract: We report strong fluorescence emissions from single IR dye molecules on a novel 3D plasmonic nanoantenna array. The measured emission cross-section is ~1E-13 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 5 orders of magnitude than the value in solution.

articleTitle: 83% Boost in external quantum efficiency of large-area 380 nm flip-chip light-emitting diodes by incorporating a self-textured oxide mask structure
abstract: The enhanced output of 380nm flip-chip light-emitting diode is demonstrated by inserting self-textured oxide structures, which was attributed the oxide structure existence not only reduces dislocation density but also intensifies the light extraction.

articleTitle: Interaction between Kerr and ionization induced nonlinear fiber optics
abstract: Light-plasma interactions are explored in gas-filled photonic crystal fibers through self-compression of few-μJ pulses. Here we study the interaction between ionization-driven soliton dynamics and Kerr-based deep-UV generation.

articleTitle: Tunable polarization-maintaining single-mode fiber laser based on a MEMS processor
abstract: A tunable from the C-band polarization-maintaining single-mode fiber laser is proposed based on a MEMS processor. The MEMS processor can select any part of the gain spectrum from the EDFA into a fiber ring, leading to a high-quality laser output.

articleTitle: Thermally-induced nonlinearity and optical bistability in Si3N4 microring resonators
abstract: We report on the nonlinear response and optical bistability in the transmitted and reflected signals of Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> microrings. Micro-second temporal dynamics of the response suggest that the nonlinear behavior is due to the thermo-optic effect.

articleTitle: Label-free bacteria detection using evanescent mode of a suspended core terahertz fiber
abstract: We propose for the first time an E. coli bacteria sensor based on the evanescent field of the fundamental mode of a suspended-core terahertz fiber. The sensor is capable of E. coli detection at concentrations in the range of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> cfu/ml. The polyethylene fiber features a 150 μm core suspended by three deeply sub-wavelength bridges in the center of a 5.1 mm-diameter cladding tube. The fiber core is biofunctionalized with T4 bacteriophages which bind and eventually destroy (lyse) their bacterial target. Using environmental SEM we demonstrate that E. coli is first captured by the phages on the fiber surface. After 25 minutes, most of the bacteria is infected by phages and then destroyed with ~1μm-size fragments remaining bound to the fiber surface. The bacteria-binding and subsequent lysis unambiguously correlate with a strong increase of the fiber absorption. This signal allows the detection and quantification of bacteria concentration. Presented bacteria detection method is label-free and it does not rely on the presence of any bacterial “fingerprint” features in the THz spectrum.

articleTitle: Planar isotropic rotor-shaped nanostructures: An alternative to develop oligomers
abstract: Polarization-independent optical properties of rotor-shaped nanostructures provide an opportunity to develop actual plasmonic systems. For instance, use of such structures in hybrid oligomers improves oligomers potential applications significantly.

articleTitle: Table-top high energy short pulse driver for sub-10 nm soft X-ray lasers
abstract: A high power, high repetition rate, Ti:Sa laser driver for the generation of table-top sub-10 nm soft X-ray lasers is discussed. It allowed lasing transition of Ni-like lanthanide ions at wavelengths down to 7.36 nm.

articleTitle: Spin-dependent plasmonics based on interfering topological defects
abstract: Spin-dependent plasmonics based on interfering topological defects in the near-field is observed. We utilize the surface plasmons scattering dynamics from localized vortex sources to create spinoptical devices as an ensemble of isolated nanoantennas.

articleTitle: Low-voltage, high-extinction-ratio, Mach-Zehnder silicon optical modulator for CMOS compatible integration
abstract: We demonstrate a carrier-depletion optical modulator with the driving voltage swing of 2 V and the extinction ratio of 12.79 dB at 12.5 Gbit/s. Even the driving voltage is reduced to 1 V, the the device still has an extinction ratio of 7.67 dB.

articleTitle: Polarization-sensitive imaging of an ensemble of modes
abstract: We describe polarization-sensitive measurements of the modal content using wide-field optical low-coherence interferometry. This polarization-sensitive cross-correlation (C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) imaging technique is well suited for characterizing the impact of polarization on the amplification dynamics in high-power fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Coherent single-photon absorption by single emitters coupled to 1D nanophotonic waveguides
abstract: We have derived an efficient model that allows calculating the dynamical single-photon absorption of an emitter coupled to a waveguide. We suggest a novel and simple structure that leads to strong single-photon absorption.

articleTitle: High-speed photodetectors in a photonic crystal platform
abstract: We demonstrate a fast photodetector (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3dB</inf> > 40GHz) integrated into a high-index contrast photonic crystal platform. Device design, fabrication and characterization are presented.

articleTitle: Realization of nano-strain-resolution fiber optic static strain sensor for geo-science applications
abstract: The first realization of nano-strain-resolution fiber optic static strain sensor is introduced. The theoretical analysis and experimental demonstration are reviewed. With this sensor, crustal deformations induced by oceanic tide and by earthquake were clearly observed.

articleTitle: Raman amplification by molecular phase modulation induced for vibrational mode of hydrogen
abstract: A two-color pump beam (401 and 481 nm) was used for molecular phase modulation of hydrogen to enhance stimulated Raman scattering for efficient frequency conversion into the entire visible/ultraviolet region.

articleTitle: Plasmonic interferometer for enhanced optical biosensing
abstract: We report a plasmonic interferometric biosensor based on a simple slit-grooves nanostructure for enhanced optical biosensing with figures of merit reaching 71.5 and detection limit of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> RIU in a simple collinear transmission optical setup.

articleTitle: Photon and polariton condensates in microcavities
abstract: In this work we study thermalisation-, coherence- and spin dynamics of photon and polariton Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs). We witness carrier distributions following the Bose Einstein distribution, buildup of long-range order and spontaneous symmetry breaking.

articleTitle: Electrically-controlled thermal infrared metamaterial devices
abstract: We demonstrate electrically-controlled thermal mid-infrared metamaterials using depletion-type semiconductor devices. This electrical tuning can find novel applications in chip-scale active infrared devices.

articleTitle: Bessel-like beams generated by photonic crystal fibre
abstract: We report a photonic crystal fibre device whose output far field resembles that of an ideal Bessel beam over a wide wavelength range. The Bessel-like beam self-heals when the central peak is obstructed.

articleTitle: Enhancement of light extraction efficiency for deep ultraviolet AlGaN quantum wells light-emitting diodes with III-nitride microspheres
abstract: Deep ultraviolet AlGaN quantum wells light-emitting diodes with III-nitride microspheres on the p-type layer shows significant light extraction efficiency enhancement (>;5.7 times) of the dominant transverse magnetic polarized spontaneous emission.

articleTitle: Rotating microparticles and bacteria with optical propelling beams
abstract: We demonstrate optical trapping and rotation of microparticles and bacteria with propelling beams. The rotation is achieved in a tweezers-like setting and fully controlled by SLM without the need of mechanical movement or phase-sensitive interference.

articleTitle: Enhanced photostability of aqueous solution of Rhodamine 6G with gold nanoparticles in lasing process by silica coating
abstract: Gold nanoparticles are mixed in aqueous solution of Rhodamine 6G to modify the lasing output intensity. The photostability deterioration of the gain medium by gold nanoparticles is successfully compensated by silica coating on the nanoparticles.

articleTitle: In-band pumped Nd:LuVO4 laser mode-locked by negative χ(2)-lens formation in an intracavity LBO crystal
abstract: self-starting χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>-lens mode-locking of an in-band pumped, Nd:LuVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser using second harmonic generation in LBO is demonstrated. Pulses as short as 4.7 ps and average powers reaching 3.1 W at 110 MHz are achieved.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-sapphire waveguides design for mid-IR evanescent field absorption gas sensors
abstract: We investigate three types of SOS waveguides suitable for evanescent field absorption based gas sensing in mid-IR. Rib and slot waveguide shows greater quasi-TE evanescent field than strip waveguide. 1.33ppm resolution is achievable.

articleTitle: Submicrometer-width TiO2 waveguides
abstract: We fabricate submicrometer-width TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> strip waveguides and measure optical losses at 633, 780, and 1550 nm. Losses of 30, 13, and 4 dB/cm (respectively) demonstrate that TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is suitable for visible-to-infrared on-chip microphotonic devices.

articleTitle: Third-order optical nonlinearity in Bulk nanoporous silicon at telecom wavelengths
abstract: Nonlinear absorption and refraction coefficients of nanoporous silicon are reported and found to be enhanced compared to those of crystalline silicon. A pump-probe measurement showing the temporal character of the nonlinearity is also presented.

articleTitle: Anderson cross-localization in photonic lattices
abstract: We report two-dimensional Anderson localization in waveguide arrays with effectively one-dimensional disorder. Although the disorder is highly anisotropic it induces strong localization along both array axes, in which the waveguide spacing is regular or disordered.

articleTitle: Disorder-enhanced nonlinear delocalization in segmented photonic lattices
abstract: We investigate the impact of nonlinearity on the perfect imaging by segmentation in photonic lattices with disorder. We find the presence of strongly localized Anderson modes renders the imaging significantly more susceptible to nonlinear perturbations.

articleTitle: Time resolved X-ray studies in semiconductor nanostructures
abstract: Time resolved X-ray diffraction has been used to study acoustic oscillations in InAs/Sb nanowires with diameters of 80 nm and 40 nm in order to determine the speed of sound in the wires.

articleTitle: Single-shot transient pulse dispersion measurement
abstract: A method capable of measuring single-laser-pulse dispersion is described. It relies on acquiring a single SHG spectrum for a fixed reference phase mask and allows studying transient phase changes in optical media.

articleTitle: Printed red-green-blue liquid crystal lasers
abstract: We present printable laser devices formed by dispersing dye-doped chiral nematic liquid crystals in solution-processible polymers. Unlike current technology, this allows lasers to be formed on a wide variety of surfaces, e.g. paper, plastic, metal.

articleTitle: Electrically injected polariton lasing from a GaAs-based microcavity under magnetic field
abstract: Suppression of relaxation bottleneck and subsequent polariton lasing is observed in a GaAs-based microcavity under the application of a magnetic field. The threshold injection current density is 0.32 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 7 Tesla.

articleTitle: A versatile scheme for read-out and actuation of nanomechanical motion using silica microspheres
abstract: We employ silica microspheres to detect and actuate nanomechanical motion. With Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-nanostrings, we achieve significant passive cooling by radiation pressure. Feedback-cooling enables stable operation at optical powers beyond the parametric-instability threshold, paving the way to detect quantum backation.

articleTitle: Ultrafast switching of hard X-rays
abstract: A 100 ps synchrotron pulse of hard X-rays is shorted to few picoseconds by exploiting coherent phonon dynamics in a thin metallic SrRuO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> layer. A first pump-probe experiment with the shortened X-ray pulse is presented.

articleTitle: Temporally nonlocal dual delay electro-optic phase dynamics, and its bifurcation scenario
abstract: An unusual bifurcation sequence exhibited in a recently proposed nonlinear delay electro-optic phase dynamics setup, is explored both experimentally and analytically. Strong agreements indicate that well-controlled dynamical complexity can be usefull in many emerging applications.

articleTitle: Semipolar (2021) blue and green InGaN light-emitting diodes
abstract: Semipolar (2021) light-emitting diodes are demonstrated with high optical polarization ratio, high indium incorporation rate, small wavelength shift and narrow spectrum width. These advantages resulted in LEDs with high efficiency and low droop.

articleTitle: Hybrid III-V semiconductor/silicon nanolasers
abstract: Heterogeneous integration of III-V semiconductors on Silicon is one the key technology for next-generation on-chip optical interconnects. During this tutorial, I will show how we extended this hybrid approach to nanophotonics by using photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Non-conservative optical forces on single particle in a single-mode waveguide
abstract: Optical forces have been traditionally decomposed into gradient force and scattering force. We show the limit of this decomposition and the non-conservative nature of optical forces, even for single particle confined in a single-mode waveguide.

articleTitle: Electrically-controlled rapid femtosecond pulse duration switching in an ultrafast Cr4+: Forsterite laser
abstract: We demonstrate fast switching between picosecond and femtosecond pulse durations from a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:forsterite laser, using an electrically-contacted GaInNAs SESAM whose absorption is controlled via the quantum confined Stark effect.

articleTitle: Ultrafast X-ray probe of nucleobase photoprotection
abstract: We will present first results of a UV-pump X-ray-probe study of the photoprotection mechanism of thymine. The experiment used element specific Auger spectroscopy and was carried out at the LCLS.

articleTitle: Determination of dioxins at ultratrace levels by femtosecond multiphoton ionization/mass spectrometry
abstract: Dioxins contained in the soil was measured by means of multiphoton ionization mass spectrometry using a femtosecond laser. By a combination with gas chromatography, congeners of dioxins were determined at femtogram levels.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant quantum repeaters for long-distance quantum communication based on quantum dots
abstract: We present a proposal for a quantum repeater which uses fault-tolerant quantum error correction to overcome decoherence limitations to creating long-distance entanglement between quantum dot spin qubits.

articleTitle: Amplification of the evanescent field of free electrons
abstract: A nanoscale plasmonic metal film can amplify free-electron evanescent fields, leading to strongly enhanced light emission via Smith-Purcell effect through a mechanism analogous to the `poor-man's superlens' for optical evanescent field enhancement.

articleTitle: Fabrication of 10-mm-thick periodically poled Mg-doped congruent LiNbO3 device for high-energy wavelength conversion
abstract: Periodically poled Mg-doped congruent LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> device with 10mm thickness of 32.2μm period was fabricated by 33kV pulse application. High-energy QPM-OPO of half-joule-class output can be expected by joule-class pumping source in 10ns pulse region.

articleTitle: Engineering of radiative and non-radiative channels in colloidal nanocrystals: Towards room-temperature efficient colloidal quantum sources
abstract: Blinking effect and multi-excitonic emission can be independently addressed by tuning both core and shell dimension. By confocal techniques measurement, we show dot-in-rods as blinking-free sources of single photon on demand at room temperature.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency of spin ensembles in a two-dimensional electron gas
abstract: We report experimental studies of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in a two-dimensional electron gas of a modulation-doped quantum well, with the aim of realizing an ideal EIT process in a solid state spin ensemble.

articleTitle: Synchronized retro-reflection-pumped femtosecond optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a practical technique for pre-oscillation threshold reduction, output power enhancement, and high frequency pulse train engineering in synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillators based on synchronized retro-reflected pumping.

articleTitle: Single-fiber for minimally-invasive identification and collection of biological species
abstract: A technology based on laser-induced fluorescence combined with microstructured fiber for micrometer-size sample detection and collection is presented. The fiber-based system introduces the possibility for real-time monitoring in in-vivo measurements.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast inter-subband relaxation and non-thermal carrier distribution in Ge/SiGe quantum wells
abstract: A systematic study of carrier relaxation in Ge quantum wells is performed applying photoluminescence and pump-probe spectroscopy. Intersubband-relaxation on a 100 fs time-scale and the presence of a non-thermal carrier distribution are identified.

articleTitle: Narrow-bandwidth, mid-infrared, seeded optical parametric generation in 90° phase-matched CdSiP2 crystal pumped by diffraction limited 500-ps pulses at 1064 nm
abstract: Low-threshold, efficient optical parametric generation at 6100 nm is demonstrated with CdSiP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at 1 to 10 kHz repetition rates with seeding at the signal wavelength employed for narrowing of the idler spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: Resonant biexciton quantum-dot cavity coupling and its potential for a fast 1.55-μm-telecom-band single photon source
abstract: We report a fast and Purcell-enhanced single photon source at 1.55 m from a biexciton of a single quantum dot coupled with a photonic crystal nanocavity. Purcell enhancement of five times is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Single molecule surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy with an optical antenna chip
abstract: We propose and fabricate a chip containing optical antennas for single molecule Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (SMSERS). We verify that SMSERS is achieved using experiments with Rhodamine 6G (R6G) isotopologues.

articleTitle: Optical stopping effect on As20S80 system film waveguide
abstract: Compared with As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">80</sub>, P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">78</sub> film waveguide deteriorates the response behavior of recovery propagation and mainly performs the slow later stage in recovery propagation process. However, for Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">79</sub>, it can improve evidently the fast earlier stage in the recovery propagation process to shorten response time to the milliseconds level, and also reduce the optical propagation loss. Experiments also show that the optical stopping effect can reach a saturated degree under He-Cd laser illumination for no less than 800ms.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical characterization of chromophore-functionalized POSS nanoparticles in a polymeric host
abstract: Chromophore-functionalized polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (POSS) was blended with a polycarbonate host and spin cast into films with <; 1.5 dB/cm loss at 1550 nm. The films were poled to a stable d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub> of 35 pm/V.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of ozone exposed to ionizing radiation
abstract: By irradiating ozone molecules with few-femtosecond soft x-ray pulses and probing the fragmentation pathways, we find that any excess energy is rapidly and efficiently transferred into internal excitation of the triatomic molecule.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength microring-based optical pulse train generator
abstract: This work extends our previous microring-based optical pulse train generator into a new design. The circuit generates a sequence of pulses with different wavelengths, and overcome the power combining limitation in the single-wavelength design.

articleTitle: Evidence for non-mass-transfer mechanism in fs-laser formation of sub-200 nm structures on sapphire
abstract: Femtosecond-laser induced generation of sub-200 nm structures in Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is reported. Comparison of experiment to theory favors periodical fluence variation while excluding self-organized mass transfer as responsible mechanism for structure formation.

articleTitle: Multiplexed classical and quantum transmission for high bitrate quantum key distribution systems
abstract: We report the operation of a gigahertz clocked quantum key distribution system, with two classical data communication channels using coarse wavelength division multiplexing over a record fibre distance of 80km.

articleTitle: Impact of semiconductor optical amplifiers in coherent down-conversion microwave photonic links
abstract: We compare the impact of conventional semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOAs) and high-linearity slab-coupled optical waveguide amplifiers (SCOWAs) on the SFDR of carrier-suppressed coherent down-conversion microwave photonic links.

articleTitle: Atmospheric volatile organic compound sensing with lasers
abstract: We present recent advances, combining novel laser technologies and spectroscopic methods, for high-sensitivity detection of volatile organic compounds within the context of the formation of secondary pollutants that affect human health and climate.

articleTitle: Polarization based plasmonic splitter and focusing device
abstract: A plasmonic “pin cushion” structure capable of splitting and focusing SPs depending on the illumination's polarization is demonstrated. It can serves as a plasmonic beam splitter, plasmonic lens and a plasmonic quadrant detector.

articleTitle: A MEMS controlled cavity optomechanical sensing system
abstract: We report a fully-integrated MEMS sensing platform enabled by cavity optomechanics. We demonstrate 4.6 fm/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> displacement sensitivity for sub-μW input power, electrostatically-tunable readout gain, and feedback damping of mechanical response by a factor of >;1000.

articleTitle: A digital phasemeter for precision length measurements
abstract: We report on a digital phasemeter for application in precision length measurement using laser interferometry. Our interferometer demonstrates a length sensitivity of 0.5 pm/√Hz above 5 Hz, and a cyclic error of better than 50 pm.

articleTitle: Evanescent-field intra-cavity sensing with a dual-wavelength distributed-feedback laser
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated optical particle sensor based on a dual-wavelength distributed-feedback waveguide laser. Micro-particles were detected down to a size of 1 μm, which represents the typical size of many fungal and bacterial pathogens.

articleTitle: Numerical dispersion compensation for optical coherence tomography on 3D microstructure
abstract: A vertically aligned liquid crystal display panel was inspected with an optical coherence tomography system. The in-depth signal dispersion was numerically compensated so that high axial resolution can be maintained throughout the 3D microstructure.

articleTitle: High-efficiency intermodal four-wave mixing in a higher-order-mode fiber
abstract: We demonstrate intermodal four-wave mixing in an all-fiber system between the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</sub> mode of a higher-order-mode fiber. Anti-Stokes and Stokes light with 2 nJ pulse energy is generated with 20% conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Quantum state tomography using photon number counting to evaluate entanglement generated by spontaneous parametric downconversion
abstract: We analyze polarization-entangled photon pairs using detectors that can or cannot count photons to discuss accuracy of the fidelity estimated by quantum state tomography. The use of four photon-number-resolving detectors presents best accuracy.

articleTitle: Fluorescence image guided surgical instruments and contrast agents for intraoperative visualization of nerves
abstract: Fluorescence image-guided surgery (FIGS) improves intraoperative visualization of critical structures. We describe the advancement of handheld and minimally invasive imaging hardware, coupled with myelin-targeting contrast agents, to bring FIGS nerve labeling closer to clinical translation.

articleTitle: GaN Nanowires synthesized by electroless etching method
abstract: Ultra-long Gallium Nitride Nanowires is synthesized via metal-electroless etching method. The morphologies and optical properties of GaN NWs show a single crystal GaN with hexagonal Wurtzite structure and high luminescence properties.

articleTitle: The nitrogen-vacancy center: Controlling quantum registers in diamond
abstract: Using the resonant optical transitions associated with individual nitrogen-vacancy defect centers, we demonstrate techniques for single-shot readout and quantum-optical connection of spin-based quantum registers in diamond.

articleTitle: Vitamin microdroplet laser
abstract: Stimulated emission from biomolecules enables a new class of biolasers for unconventional approaches in biomedical applications. We demonstrate vitamin microdroplet laser using riboflavin 5'-monophosphate sodium salt hydrate (a form of vitamin B2).

articleTitle: Direct measurement of the dependence of the photon-number distribution on the number of modes in parametric down-conversion
abstract: The dependence of the photon-number distribution from parametric down-conversion on the number of collected modes is directly measured using Silicon Photomultiplier number-resolving detectors. Measurements are analyzed using a novel crosstalk model.

articleTitle: Increased maximum count rates in single-photon avalanche diodes with ultrafast active quenching
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast active-quenching techniques in a silicon single-photon avalanche diode, and observe an order of magnitude reduction in afterpulsing, a factor of 1.8 reduction in diode recovery time, and increased maximum count rates.

articleTitle: Silicon quantum photonic sources and circuits
abstract: Elementary components required for photonic quantum information processing are realised in a silicon-on-insulator platform. On-chip quantum interference, manipulation of entangled states and photon-pair generation in a ring resonator with record high coincidental-to-accidental rates are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fiber delivered two-color picosecond source through nonlinear spectral transformation for coherent Raman scattering imaging
abstract: We demonstrate a two-color fiber-delivered picosecond source and its application to coherent Raman scattering imaging. The pump and the Stokes pulses are generated through nonlinear spectral compression and broadening in optical fibers, respectively.

articleTitle: Monolithically-integrated polarization-entangled photon pair source on a silicon-on-insulator photonic circuit
abstract: We present a polarization-entangled photon pair source fully integrated on a silicon photonic circuit. Using two silicon wire waveguides connected with a silicon polarization rotator, we demonstrate a generation of polarization-entangled photons.

articleTitle: Quantitative measurement of scattering and absorption cross-sections of individual metal nano-antennas
abstract: Using a common-path interferometer combined with a spatial modulation technique, we simultaneously measure the absolute absorption and scattering cross-sections of individual metal nano-objects such as split-ring resonators or straight antennas.

articleTitle: Generation of polarization shaped terahertz waves
