abstract: Terahertz polarization shaping technique is developed. We have used the combination of wedge-type diffractive optical components in conjunction with a circular InAs pattern to produce various THz waves with temporally-evolving polarization states.

articleTitle: Pyramidal microcavities for improved optically and electrically driven single-photon sources
abstract: Reversed pyramidal GaAs microcavities with embedded InAs quantum dots have been fabricated, in order to prove their potential for highly efficient single-photon emitters. Contacted via tiny bridges, they have been driven optically and electrically.

articleTitle: Plasmon enhanced cultivation of cyanobacteria for bioenergy
abstract: A method of cell cultivation is presented in which photosynthetic cyanobacteria cells are grown by excitation of their photocenters by a plasmon enhanced evanescent field on the surface of thin gold films.

articleTitle: 62 mW output power, room-temperature operation, CW interband cascade laser
abstract: We report an output power of 62 mW in an interband cascade laser operated cw at room-temperature (T = 20 °C), with an internal loss of 4.9cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, and a threshold current density as low as 320A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Arrayed nanoantennas for efficient broadband unidirectional emission enhancement
abstract: Plasmonic Yagi-Uda nanoantennas are narrowband because their bandwidth is compromised by their unidirectionality. We propose and study arrayed nanoantennas offering broadband unidirectional emission enhancement with a high radiation efficiency.

articleTitle: High-speed imaging of OH radicals in flames using fiber-coupled UV-PLIF
abstract: A fiber-coupled, high-speed UV-PLIF system employing a long multimode silica fiber is developed for detection of OH in harsh combustion environments. Single-laser-shot, 10kHz, OH-PLIF imaging of unsteady flames is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Absorption bleaching in silicon via high-power terahertz pulses: Carrier dependence
abstract: We present optical pump / high-power THz probe measurements for undoped silicon at different optical pump fluences. We observe an absorption bleaching of intense terahertz (THz) pulses, which decreases with increasing optical pump fluence.

articleTitle: Fabrication and optical characterization of high-Q guided mode resonances in a graphite-lattice photonic crystal slab
abstract: Photonic-crystal slabs based on the graphite lattice have been fabricated in silicon-on-insulator and optically characterized. Guided mode resonances were measured with quality factors up to 9800 in air and up to 8600 in water.

articleTitle: An ultrasensitive optofluidic nucleic acid biosensor
abstract: Amplification-free nucleic acid testing using molecular beacon detection on an optofluidic chip is reported. A limit of detection at the single molecule detection level (10pM) and excellent specificity (single nucleotide mismatches) is observed.

articleTitle: Unified microscopic-macroscopic picture of high harmonic generation from the VUV to the keV X-ray region
abstract: We present a unified picture of phase matching of high harmonic upconversion spanning the electromagnetic spectrum from the VUV to keV, combining both microscopic and macroscopic physics. We validate this picture with experiment and theory.

articleTitle: From quantum multiplexing to fault-tolerant quantum computing
abstract: We present a scheme that permits the reliable creation of entanglement between pairs of distant qubits. We consider its application to the creation of a topological cluster state in a distributed quantum computer.

articleTitle: High-resolution spectral-domain optical coherence tomography with microfiber coupler
abstract: We demonstrate a spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT) using a microfiber coupler with an insertion loss of ~0.5-dB over 900-nm bandwidth. The axial resolution of the SD-OCT is measured to be ~2 um.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of multiple gas species using a Nd3+:YAG laser combined with Raman scattering
abstract: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering technique combined with a single pulsed Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG laser is proposed and demonstrated for simultaneous measurement of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. The technique can be used in combustion measurement consisting of gas mixture.

articleTitle: Observation of antiferromagnetic magnons in manganese oxide by THz-TDS
abstract: We observed the antiferromagnetic resonance absorption in MnO by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS). The temperature dependences of the magnon frequency, the relaxation rate, and the magnetostrictive contribution to refractive index are discussed.

articleTitle: Scattering loss in thin, shallow-ridge silion-on-insulator waveguides
abstract: Roughness induced scattering in thin, shallow-ridge silicon on insulator waveguides is analyzed by coupled mode theory and verified experimentally. Roughness in different waveguide regions causes different scattering natures of TM and TE modes.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic generation microscopy of carbon nanotubes
abstract: We image an individual single-walled carbon nanotube (SWNT) by second-harmonic generation (SHG) and transmission electron microscopy and propose that SHG microscopy could be used to probe the handedness of chiral SWNTs.

articleTitle: Multiple microwave frequencies acquiring by photonics-assisted compressive sampling
abstract: Multiple microwave frequencies sensing ranging from 15 to 20 GHz is reported based on compressive sampling. A maximum detection error of 150 kHz is achieved using a single ADC with analog bandwidth of 826.75 MHz.

articleTitle: Spontaneous coherence in a cold exciton gas
abstract: We report on the measurement of spontaneous coherence in a gas of indirect excitons. Extended spontaneous coherence, spin texture, and phase singularities emerge when the exciton gas is cooled below a few Kelvin.

articleTitle: Optical properties of low loss (70dB/km) Kagome hollow core photonic crystal fiber for Rb and Cs based optical applications
abstract: We report on hollow-core Kagome fiber with a record loss of 70dB/km and operating at ∼800nm. We show experimentally that the bending-loss is limited by coupling between the guiding core mode and the modes in the cladding holes.

articleTitle: Self-assembled ferroelectric nano-domain gratings in bulk RKTP
abstract: We present the fabrication of self-assembled bulk domain gratings of sub-μm periodicity in Rb-doped KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystals. The structures are used to demonstrate QPM backwards propagating non-collinear second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: 1.4ps superradiant pulses from a GaN-based laser
abstract: The generation of picosecond superradiant pulses from 408nm a GaN/InGaN laser diode is demonstrated for the first time. Pulses with peak powers above 2.8W, pulse energy of 57pJ and durations of 1.4ps are generated.

articleTitle: Guided Bloch Surface Wave polaritons: A route towards polariton circuits
abstract: We report on the strong coupling between a single quantum-well and guided Bloch Surface Waves. This results in a guided polariton that may serve as a component for the realization of "polaritonic integrated circuits".

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of oblivious transfer in the noisy storage model
abstract: We report on the first experimental implementation of 1-2 random oblivious transfer in the noisy storage model using a modified entangled quantum key distribution (QKD) system implementing Schaffner's simple protocol.

articleTitle: Generation of ultra-broadband infrared pulses through difference frequency mixing
abstract: Ultra-broadband infrared pulses were generated through difference frequency mixing with BBO crystal. The spectra range of the generated infrared pulse was above one octave, with pulse duration 39fs and pulse energy of 15μJ.

articleTitle: Femtosecond induced fiber mode filter
abstract: We demonstrate a mode filter by inducing a short distance refractive index increase around the fiber core. The guidance of the fiber is modified and higher order modes can be suppressed.

articleTitle: Evidence of non-vanishing excitonic correlation near the exciton Mott transition in Si revealed by THz time domain spectroscopy
abstract: We investigate the Coulomb correlation in electron-and-hole system in Si using optical-pump-terahertz-probe spectroscopy. Excitonic correlation is observed even above the Mott density accompanied by coupled behavior of plasmon and exciton.

articleTitle: Green LEDs and solar cells based on ZnTe-related materials
abstract: Recent research results on a green LED and solar cell based on ZnTe are reported. The wall plug efficiency of ZnTe LED has been improved to 0.15% by adopting a thin film structure, which is comparable to that of GaP-based green LED. The solar cell based on ZnTe with an efficiency of 1.42% has also been developed. The fundamental results on ZnTe solar cell provide a basis for future development of intermediate band solar cells based on ZnTe-related materials.

articleTitle: Deep-well quantum cascade laser structure on metamorphic buffer layer
abstract: A novel deep-well tapered-active quantum cascade laser design (λ~3.6 μm) on a metamorphic buffer layer (MBL) virtual substrate is achieved. Strain-compensated superlattice structures, representative of the QCL active region, are grown on the MBL.

articleTitle: Optical trapping of metal-dielectric nanoparticle clusters near photonic crystal microcavities
abstract: We predict the formation of a stably trapped metal-dielectric nanoparticle cluster near a photonic crystal cavity. The cavity mode traps a gold particle, which provides a secondary trapping site for a pair of dielectric particles.

articleTitle: Temperature measurements of cluster fusion plasmas using D−3 He or CD4−3 He mixtures on the Texas Petawatt
abstract: We present a novel way of determining the plasma temperature in a laser-cluster fusion experiment on the Texas Petawatt laser, which uses the ratio of the 2.45 MeV neutron and 14.7 MeV proton yields.

articleTitle: Atomic diffusion effects on the coherent storage of an image using a gradient echo memory in a warm atomic vapor
abstract: We experimentally study the effect of atomic diffusion on the quality of an image stored in the long-lived ground state coherence of a warm atomic ensemble using a gradient echo memory.

articleTitle: Internal quantum efficiency in light-emitting diodes based on the width of efficiency-versus-carrier-concentration curve
abstract: Based on the ABC model, we derive a relationship between the internal quantum efficiency (IQE) and the width of the efficiency-versus-carrier-concentration curve. We determine the IQE of LEDs at temperatures ranging from 100K to 300K.

articleTitle: Mapping |Ex|2, |Ez|2 and |Hy|2 for one-dimensional surface plasmon polaritons
abstract: We measure, using dual-mode scanning near field optical microscopy [1], the magnetic component of surface plasmon polariton separately from the electric components.

articleTitle: Frequency comb synthesizer tunable from 3 to 10 μm
abstract: We demonstrate a mid-infrared frequency comb of unprecedented tunability covering the entire 3-10 μm fingerprint region. The comb is based on a Raman shifted Yb:fiber laser and difference frequency generation.

articleTitle: Blocker size effects on extraordinary light transmission through subwavelength holes in opaque thin metal film
abstract: We studied the extraordinary light transmission through opaque thin metal film with subwavelength holes blocked by metal disks. The maximum transmission is achieved when the disk diameter is around 80 nm even with different hole diameters.

articleTitle: Burst-mode Yb fiber amplifier producing 40 μJ individual pulse energy
abstract: We report 40-μJ individual pulse energy for 100-ns long amplified bursts with homogenized energy distribution from a 1-kHz Yb-fiber amplifier. Initial results on micromachining using burst-mode femtosecond pulses are presented for the first time.

articleTitle: High power cw diamond Raman laser: Analysis of efficiency and parasitic loss
abstract: We report an investigation into a 8.2 W diamond Raman laser with conversion efficiency of 27% pumped by a cw Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser. Power analysis enables determination of the factors limiting conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Planar waveguide architecture for the implementation of a network of optically controlled quantum dot spin qubits
abstract: We propose a device architecture for an in-plane network of optically connected quantum dots. At each node of the network, the dot resides at the intersection of two orthogonal waveguides which transmit the full polarization of an emitted photon to another node. A prototype device is presented.

articleTitle: Large area periodic nanogap arrays for Raman and fluorescence enhancement: Modeling and performance
abstract: We will discuss the use of dense periodic nanogap arrays for plasmonic sensing applications. A high-throughput fabrication process will be presented, that yields nanogap arrays with periodicities above 150 nm, and with accurately controlled gap widths of ±1.5 nm over mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> large areas.

articleTitle: Conjugate Fabry-Perot cavity pair for astro-combs
abstract: We propose a new mode-filtering scheme for astro-combs using two Fabry-Perot cavities: a “conjugate Fabry-Perot cavity pair”. Simulations suggest that this scheme improves astro-comb accuracy in the presence of errors from nonlinear fibers.

articleTitle: Luminescence of ZnO films covered by Ag: Influenceof excitation level and Ag covering method
abstract: Luminescence investigations of ZnO films covered by Ag films using different pumping sources revealed that influence of Ag films on the intensity of ZnO films luminescence depends on excitation conditions and Ag covering quality.

articleTitle: High power mode locked quantum dash 1.5 μm laser with asymmetrical cladding
abstract: We present a quantum dash laser with more than 120 mW/facet at 1.2 A based on an asymmetrical cladding. Passive mode-locking with an RF -3dB linewidth of 3.2 kHz at 20.7 GHz has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Measuring photon statistics with live photoreceptor cells
abstract: We study the response of an isolated rod photoreceptor under stimulation by well characterized coherent and pseudo-thermal light sources. The results reveal a crucial effect of the cell photobleaching on the statistics of its response.

articleTitle: Excitonic energy transfer dynamics in hybrid organic/inorganic nanocomposites at high loading levels
abstract: Temperature dependent exciton migration in the hybrid nanocomposites of conjugated polymers chemically integrated with quantum dots is studied at high loading levels. The underlying interplay between the exciton transfer and diffusion is revealed.

articleTitle: Using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy to determine the glass transition temperature of heavy oils
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy is used to measure the temperature-dependent refractive index of heavy oils down to 80 K. Evidence for a glass transition is observed, providing insight into the viscosity-temperature behavior of heavy oils.

articleTitle: High-quality pulse-compression of pre-chirped pulses in fiber-amplifiers
abstract: We combine steady-state propagation-rate equation and generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation to accurately model high-repetition rate femtosecond Yb-fiber amplifiers. Such modeling reveals the nonlinear-evolution dynamics of the amplified pulse and allows the optimization of the compressed-pulse quality.

articleTitle: A quantum random number generator based on photon number resolving detection of successive photon pulses
abstract: We demonstrated a quantum random number generator based on the inherent randomness of photon number distributed in individual pulses, measured by using a silicon multipixel photon counter. The random bit generation efficiency reached over 40%.

articleTitle: Plasmonic metasurfaces: Manipulating light on a surface
abstract: We discuss theoretically and experimentally how plasmonic metasurfaces can largely control and manipulate the polarization state of light. By using ultrathin plasmonic arrays, circular polarization conversion and filtering is achieved over subwavelength distances.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of helical structures via proximity-field nano-patterning (PnP) for application as chiral metamaterials
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a genetic algorithm based inverse design technique to target and fabricate helical structures via PnP. We furthermore show their inversion into other functional materials and their application as chiral metamaterials.

articleTitle: Boundary-induced Anderson localization in a photonic lattice
abstract: We prove experimentally asymptotic Anderson localization inside the bulk of a two-dimensional, finite, periodic array of weakly-coupled optical waveguides with a disordered boundary.

articleTitle: Micro-gear resonator for direct coupling to normal-incident waves
abstract: We show a diffraction-based coupling scheme that allows a high-Q micro-resonator to directly manipulate a free-space optical beam at normal incidence. The normal-incident transmission and reflection change 40% over a wavelength range of 0.3 nm.

articleTitle: Generation of 32nd harmonic in passively mode-locked erbium-doped laser with graphene saturable absorber
abstract: We report passive mode locking of a soliton erbium-doped fiber laser based on graphene saturable absorber at repetition rate continuously scalable up to 500 MHz. The supermodes are suppressed by 50 dB at 32<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> harmonic.

articleTitle: Steering surface plasmons on metal surface
abstract: We proposed a new approach to modulate the beam phase of propagating surface Plasmon polariton (SPP) wave by in-plane diffractions, so as to steer SPP beam property. SPP Airy beams and broadband focusing were realized.

articleTitle: From isolated metaatoms to photonic metamaterials: Mapping of collective near-field phenomena with EELS
abstract: We investigate the evolution of plasmonic modes during the transition from metaatoms to photonic metamaterials by electron energy-loss spectroscopy. Interactions between metaatoms have a strong effect on the near-field distribution of metamaterials.

articleTitle: Demonstration of reconfigurable directed logic in silicon photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We show a scalable and reconfigurable optical logic architecture based on a regular array of integrated optical switches. We present a proof-of-principle demonstration with a 2 ×2 switch array that can perform arbitrary two-input logic functions.

articleTitle: Multi-pulse addressing of a Raman quantum memory: Configurable beam splitting and efficient readout
abstract: We address an optical quantum memory with multiple pulses, enabling unit efficiency readout and programmable beam splitting. The resulting coherent processor with built-in storage is universal for scalable photonic quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Reference-free focal spot optimization of a petawatt laser using adaptive optics
abstract: A novel approach on wavefront correction using adaptive optics has been demonstrated at PHELIX. This reference-free method minimizes the focal spot size by taking advantage of the orthogonality of the underlying Zernike polynomials.

articleTitle: Integrated all-optical 4-input NOR logic gate based on InP technology
abstract: In this work we present an integrated all-optical 4-input NOR logic gate fabricated on InP technology and comprising a fabricated SOA operating at 25 Gb/s and a wavelength demultiplexer. This logic gate may be the base for the development of 4-input look-up tables, needed for the development of larger-scale all optical programmable devices.

articleTitle: High power extraction in (THz) surface-emitting lasers using type-II photonic heterostructures
abstract: We report high-power, single-mode surface-emission from THz quantum cascade (QC) lasers with a type-II photonic heterostructure (PHS) resonator. Such resonator selectively excites the unusual radiative mode with significantly enhanced radiation efficiency. The PHS lasers (f ~ 3.4 THz) exhibit peak output powers of 103 mW at 20K, and the maximum operation temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>) is 120K in pulsed mode. PHS lasers also show a directional single-lobed far-field pattern with a typical divergence angle of 20°×9°.

articleTitle: Ultrafast supercontinuum spectroscopy of multiple exciton states in lead chalcogenide nanorods and nanocrystals
abstract: We examine the multiple exciton population dynamics in lead chalcogenide nanostructures by ultrafast supercontinuum transient absorption. Carrier multiplication is revealed in the limit of low absorbed photon number, along with biexciton dynamics.

articleTitle: THz near-field imaging based on a tapered parallel-plates
abstract: A Broad-band low-loss no-cut-off THz near-field imaging technique has been demonstrated experimentally. Using a tapered parallel-plate waveguide as a probe this technique is able to resolve sub-wavelength (λ ~ 600 μm-6 mm) features of size ~100 μm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a relaxed waveguide semipolar InGaN/GaN laser diode
abstract: Growth on relaxed buffers provides a potential route to reduce difficulties caused by high strain (∼ 3%) in the In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.7</inf>N active regions of green laser diodes (LDs). We demonstrate a blue LD with partially relaxed n- and p-side waveguide/cladding interfaces.

articleTitle: Coherence imaging for early cancer detection
abstract: We have developed multiple spectroscopic coherence imaging methods to assess pre-cancerous states by isolating scattering signatures from specific tissue locations. We describe the basis, validation and development of the approaches and recent clinical results.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electron-hole scattering monitored by hole cooling in optically excited Germanium quantum wells
abstract: The scattering and cooling dynamics in Ge quantum wells are investigated on a picosecond time scale. Time-resolved pump-probe experiments reveal an efficient scattering process between electrons in the L-valley and holes in the Γ-valley.

articleTitle: Development of efficient broadband green light source by tandem quasi-phase-matched structure
abstract: Broadband green light source using a 5.5-mm-long tandem PPLN was demonstrated. The measured wavelength and temperature bandwidth were 13nm and 100°C, respectively, which had 34.2 times broader spectral bandwidth than periodic one.

articleTitle: Feasibility of multimode polycrystalline waveguides/devices: Record low propagation loss and uniform 1×12 MMI fanout
abstract: We investigate the loss dependence of multimode polysilicon waveguide widths, achieving a record low propagation loss of 3 dB/cm as well as demonstrating a low loss and high uniformity 1×12 multimode interference (MMI) beam splitter.

articleTitle: Observation of spontaneous parametric down conversion in LiNbO3 waveguide arrays
abstract: We study experimentally the process of bi-photon generation through spontaneous parametric down-conversion in waveguide arrays. We show the formation of a unique spatial-spectral photon pattern and its dependence on the phase-matching conditions.

articleTitle: Lasing modes in polycrystalline and amorphous structures
abstract: We systematically studied the lasing characteristics in photonic polycrystalline and amorphous structures under optical pumping. The lasing modes are spatially localized, and blue shift as the structural order becomes short ranged.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nano-protractor based on polarization spectro-tomography
abstract: We propose and experimentally realize a “plasmonic protractor”: a spectroscopic device capable of detecting the orientation, position, and length of a small optically dark object using the polarization-resolved dark field microscopy.

articleTitle: Microparticle trapping and sensing with an integrated silicon microdonut
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated system for particle trapping and sorting. Particles are pulled by optical forces onto a silicon microdonut, and circulate around it. Particle-induced resonance shifts are used for size sensing and counting.

articleTitle: Grating-induced vortices in photonic crystal fiber: A pathway to ultra-high temperature sensing
abstract: We demonstrate vortex generation in a PCF, enabled by a micro-bend grating produced by structural deformations alone. The grating-resonance is stable at temperatures exceeding 1000 C, yielding a platform for realizing ultra-high-temperature sensors.

articleTitle: Positively chirped pulses in a mode-locked thulium fiber laser — Simulation and experiment
abstract: We report on positively chirped pulse operation of a passively mode-locked thulium-doped fiber laser with fiber-based dispersion management. Numerical simulations provide deeper insight into the evolution and the limitations of the pulse parameters.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser writing in transparent materials: From physics to applications
abstract: Properties of optical materials can be modified with sub-wavelength precision using intense ultrashort light pulses. New science and emerging applications of ultrafast laser writing in transparent materials are reviewed.

articleTitle: Novel injector schemes for Mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers, toward the genetic optimization of the laser design
abstract: Using a novel transport model based on density matrix, a new injector design for Mid-IR quantum-cascade-lasers is presented that improves laser performance. Results on automatized optimization of laser design using genetic algorithms are also shown.

articleTitle: Non-adiabatic atomic coherence at work in the oxygen laser source for atmospheric remote sensing
abstract: We pump ambient air by loosely-focused ultraviolet pulses and generate a backward laser-like beam for use in remote sensing. We find that this efficient emission is likely linked to non-adiabatic coherence effects in atomic oxygen.

articleTitle: Space-based lidar systems
abstract: An overview of space-based lidar systems is presented, from the first laser altimeter on APOLLO 15 mission in 1971 to the Mercury Laser Altimeter on MESSENGER mission currently in orbit, and those currently under development.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent Fano resonances in one dimensional arrays of core-shell nanospheres
abstract: We study light scattering by one-dimensional arrays of core-shell nanospheres and reveal the existence of polarization-independent Fano resonances due to the interference of degenerate magneto-electric Mie resonances with Wood's anomaly of the array.

articleTitle: Observation of optical k∼0 high-Q Fano resonances in macroscopic photonic crystal slabs
abstract: In an infinite periodic PhC slab, due to symmetry considerations, Fano resonances at k=0 completely decouple from the external world and their radiative quality factors become infinite despite lying above the light line. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the existence of such resonances at k∼0.

articleTitle: Assessment of an open path Quantum Cascade Laser system for simultaneous retrieval of ambient methane and nitrous-oxide concentrations
abstract: The development a field-deployable dual Methane □ Nitrous-oxide open-path sensors using a chirped pulse tuned (1297.4-1298.8cm-1) Quantum Cascade Laser is discussed. Results using multipass gas cells are presented as well as preliminary field results.

articleTitle: Spatial overlap modulation nonlinear optical microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate nonlinear optical microscopy modulating the spatial overlap between two-color pulses, which provides the enhancement of the three-dimensional spatial resolution and the suppression of the out-of-focus signals in deep imaging.

articleTitle: Phase stabilization of a Yb:Fiber frequency comb via high-bandwidth transducers
abstract: We report a Yb:fiber frequency comb using an intra-cavity electro-optic modulator and an acousto-optic modulator outside the cavity. The integrated phase noise error was 112mrad for f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> and 564mrad for an optical lock at 698nm.

articleTitle: Atom interferometry via Raman chirped adiabatic passage
abstract: Practical atom interferometric sensors may benefit from robust atom optics based on Raman chirped adiabatic passage (RCAP). We demonstrate coherent transfer and interference using RCAP, and discuss expected enhancement of interferometer stability.

articleTitle: Silica microfibres for broadband third harmonic generation
abstract: We report broadband third harmonic generation via intermodal phase matching in silica microfibres of several centimetres. A 5 dB conversion bandwidth exceeding 36 nm was recorded, with harmonic power detected over a 150 nm range.

articleTitle: Digital Petri dish for on-chip cell monitoring
abstract: We report a digital Petri dish platform for on-chip cell monitoring. We demonstrate the ability to image confluent cell cultures with 6 mm × 4 mm filed-of-view and ~0.7 μm resolution by using the proposed platform.

articleTitle: Dynamic decoupling of spin-lattice-charge excitations in iron pnictides using time-resolved laser ellipsometry
abstract: We report distinct dynamics of magnetic, electronic anisotropy and charge excitations in parent and weakly Co-doped BaFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, which identify the manifestation of the Ising nematic symmetry and, its contribution to magneto-structural phase transition.

articleTitle: Green synthesis of sub-10 nm gold nanoparticles by two-step laser irradiation
abstract: Size control of laser synthesized gold nanoparticles in different solvents is reported. Our two-step green-synthesis approach employs only the fundamental harmonic of a Nd:YAG laser at kHz repetition rates for sub-10 nm nanoparticles production.

articleTitle: Stretched-pulse operation of a thulium-doped fiber laser with a fiber-based dispersion management
abstract: A normal-dispersion fiber was used for dispersion management in an ultrafast thulium-doped fiber laser. The laser provided pulse durations below 130 fs with an external pulse compression. The experimental results could be numerically verified.

articleTitle: 13-mJ, single frequency, sub-nanosecond Nd:YAG laser at kHz repetition rate with near diffraction limited beam quality
abstract: Near diffraction limited, single frequency, passively Q-switched Nd:YAG laser (240-μJ, 830-ps at 0.5-kHz) is amplified up to 13-mJ in a three-stage diode pumped amplifier whilst preserving pulse duration, beam quality and linear polarization.

articleTitle: Reliable carrier-envelope phase control for current and future attosecond experiments
abstract: Feed-forward carrier-envelope phase (CEP) stabilization yields few-cycle pulses with unparalleled long-term precision. We show first results on the CEP control of pulses from a thin-disk laser, representing possible future attosecond driver sources.

articleTitle: Accurate measurement of the external quantum efficiency of multi-junction solar cells
abstract: A pulsed voltage bias method is used to accurately measure the external quantum efficiency (EQE) of multi-junction solar cells by controlling the electrical and optical coupling between subcells.

articleTitle: Nonlinear THz spectroscopy of graphene
abstract: Carrier dynamics in graphene at low energies are studied using two-dimensional THz spectroscopy. Pump-probe signals much faster than the acoustic phonon energy are observed due to a combination of intra- and interband absorption.

articleTitle: Picosecond thin-disk amplifiers with high average power for pumping optical parametric amplifiers
abstract: Short-pulse-pumped optical parametric amplification (OPA) calls for picosecond lasers with high average powers. We report on the current thin-disk laser development, the synchronization between pump and seed sources and first OPA results.

articleTitle: Resonantly pumped, Q-switched Nd:YLF laser
abstract: We developed a compact, efficient Nd:YLF laser that produced 25-mJ of energy in a 8-ns pulse at 20 Hz. By resonantly pumping at 863 nm, 10% improvement in the slope efficiency was obtained.

articleTitle: MAP-fabricated repositionable micro-ring resonators for in-line side-polished fiber devices
abstract: Micro-ring resonators with good performance were fabricated using multi-photon absorption polymerization (MAP) on PDMS and directly pressed against SPF producing variable resonances in the optical output spectrum depending on positioning and pressure.

articleTitle: Ultrafast non-thermal electron dynamics in single layer graphene
abstract: We study the ultrafast dynamics of non-thermal electron relaxation in graphene upon impulsive excitation. The 10-fs resolution two color pump-probe allows us to unveil the non-equilibrium electron gas decay at early times.

articleTitle: Optical limiting and femtosecond transient absorption measurements in a solution-processable low bandgap quinoidal oligothiophene derivative
abstract: To study the photophysical properties of the quinoidal oligothiophene derivative [QQT(CN)4], we measured the optical limiting and transient absorption properties in both solution and thin films using femtosecond laser and ultrafast pump probe experiment, respectively.

articleTitle: Phase-locked Raman frequency comb generation in gas-filled hollow-core PCF
abstract: Starting from a microchip laser and a Stokes seed generated from noise in a hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber, we generate a phase-locked, octave-spanning, purely rotational frequency comb.

articleTitle: Trapped rainbow techniques for spectroscopy on a chip and fluorescence enhancement
abstract: We have fabricated a large area array of tapered nano-waveguides, which exhibit broadband “trapped rainbow” effect. Considerable fluorescence enhancement due to slow light behavior in the array has been observed.

articleTitle: Nondestructive calibration of Chirped Fiber Bragg Grating sensors using a fiber-based ultrafast laser
abstract: Chirped Fiber Bragg Gratings (CFBG) sensors are powerful high-speed strain detectors for various applications like traffic monitoring or detonation measurement. Here we present a novel, non-destructive calibration for CFBGs using a femtosecond fiber laser.

articleTitle: Nonlinear-polarization-evolution mode-locking in a hybrid cavity: A route toward low repetition-rate fiber lasers
abstract: We demonstrate nonlinear-polarization-evolution mode-locking in a ring-cavity Yb-fiber oscillator consisting of both polarization-maintaining (PM) and non-PM fibers. A femtosecond Yb-fiber oscillator at 12-MHz repetition-rate with 10-nJ pulse energy is implemented employing this hybrid cavity.

articleTitle: Demonstration of coupled high Q-factor surface nanoscale axial photonics (SNAP) microresonators
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of coupled identical super-high Q-factor bottle microresonators formed by periodic nanoscale variation of the optical fiber radius. The Q-factor of the fabricated microresonator series exceeds 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>.

articleTitle: CMOS compatible monolithic 1st and 2nd order all-optical integrator
abstract: We demonstrate 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order all-optical ultra-high speed temporal integration of complex optical waveforms by using an integrated CMOS compatible four-port micro-ring resonator. The device offers an unprecedented processing speed >; 400 GHz.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning supercontinuum generation of vortices in a As2S3 ring photonic crystal fiber
abstract: As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ring PCF is proposed for vortex modes. Two orders of magnitude improvement on mode separation is achieved. Engineered dispersion and high nonlinearity enable octave-spanning supercontinuum generation from 1196 to 2418 nm within 1-cm fiber.

articleTitle: Relativistic physics in optical waveguide arrays: Simulating the Dirac equation
abstract: In contrast to popular belief, it is possible to simulate a relativistic Dirac equation in classical paraxial optical waveguide arrays. Here, we present various simulations of relativistic phenomena in different structures, including so-called “optical graphene”.

articleTitle: High-speed single-photon detection at 1550 nm via cascaded frequency upconversion
abstract: We demonstrate two-stage upconversion of single-photon signals from 1550 nm to the green spectral region with 87% internal efficiency with low excess noise, enabling sub-70-ps timing-jitter detection with Si avalanche photodiodes.

articleTitle: Highly efficient KY1−x−yGdxLuy(WO4)2:Tm3+ channel waveguide lasers
abstract: Laser experiments on 1.5at.%, 5at.%, and 8at.% thulium-gadolinium-lutetium-yttrium co-doped, buried, ridge-type channel waveguides in a monoclinic potassium double tungstate demonstrate a maximum slope efficiency of 70% and output powers of 300 mW at ~1.9 μm.

articleTitle: Observation of Brillouin cooling
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the energy-reversed counterpart to Brillouin lasers, resulting in the cooling of Brownian surface-acoustic-wave whispering-gallery resonances by light in a silica microsphere resonator.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of the frequency noise and linewidth of a mid-IR DFB quantum cascade laser
abstract: We present the frequency noise and linewidth of a quantum cascade laser measured for the first time with the same device from cryogenic to room-temperature. A strong increase of the linewidth occurs at low temperature.

articleTitle: One-dimensional massless Dirac-particles in waveguide arrays with alternating coupling
abstract: We experimentally realized a waveguide device with alternating positive and negative coupling and show that this geometry is an optical simulator of the conditions found for a massless relativistic particle described by the one-dimensional Dirac-equations.

articleTitle: Laser printing of organic electronics
abstract: This work presents the direct laser printing process for the fabrication of organic electronics. A Nd:YAG laser is used to print organic (P3HT, PQT) and inorganic materials (Ag nanoparticles) on various substrates.

articleTitle: Large area GaN/AlN nanowire resonant tunneling devices on silicon
abstract: We have demonstrated, for the first time, resonant tunneling in large area nanowire devices on Si substrates, wherein GaN/AlN multiple quantum wells are incorporated in nearly-defect free GaN nanowires on a Si-platform.

articleTitle: Large area single-mode PT-symmetric laser amplifiers
abstract: We propose a new method in realizing single-mode large area laser amplifiers that is based on the recently developed notion of parity-time symmetry in optics.

articleTitle: Frequency locked micro disk resonator for improved sensing resolution and overcoming perturbations in NSOM measurements
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate locking of a laser frequency to a resonance line of a micro disk resonator. Achieving 1±0.1 pm shifting detection, the approach can be applied for sensing enhancement and perturbation immune NSOM measurements.

articleTitle: Quantitative modeling of the nonlinear ultrafast response in a plasmonic system
abstract: We demonstrate how a plasmonic nanoantenna can act as tunable resonant material that enhances third harmonic generation. We are able to quantitatively model the nonlinear spectrum with a nonlinear oscillator in position, shape, and amplitude.

articleTitle: Deep sub-wavelength plasmonic lithography with antisymmetric surface plasmon mode
abstract: We propose a method for deep-subwavelength patterns using antisymmetric surface plasmon mode in metal/dielectric multilayer metamaterials. Interference patterns with feature size of 22nm(~λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">incident</sub>/20) and fabrication of the device are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical fiber tips functionalized with semiconductor photonic crystal cavities
abstract: We develop a new method to transfer photonic crystal resonators to the tips of optical fibers. High Q (2000–4000) cavities are coupled via transmission or PL emission to the fibers in both Si and GaAs.

articleTitle: Phase separation and pattern instability of laser-induced polymerization in liquid-crystal-monomer mixtures
abstract: Directly written by a ultra-short femto-second laser pulse, we report the phase separation and pattern formation induced by polymerization in a liquid-crystal-monomer mixture. By varying the scanning speed of optical fields along a line, pattern transitions of photon-induced polymer structures are illustrated in shapes of double-humped, single-humped, and broken stripes. The optical microscope images taken in experiments are in a good agreement with numerical simulations based on a modified set of coupled 2 + 1 dimensional diffusion equations. The demonstration in this work provides a step for controlling phase separation morphologies as well as transferring patterns in polymer-dispersed liquid crystals.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of bosonic quantum interference of single surface plasmon polaritons
abstract: We have demonstrated the Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) type interference experiment with single surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) excited via single-photons. When two SSPPs were simultaneously incident at each input port of a 50/50 directional coupler, photons emerged together in one output or the other, which is the evidence that the quantum interference of SSPPs is bosonic.

articleTitle: Coherent optical control a single hole spin in a quantum dot
abstract: We report coherent optical control of a single hole spin confined to an InAs/GaAs quantum dot. The hole spin was initialized by fast dissociation of a spin-polarized electron-hole pair, and controlled by combining coherent rotations about two perpendicular axes: Larmor precession about an external Voigt-geometry magnetic field, and optical rotation caused by the geometric phase shift induced by a picosecond laser pulse.

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength, interferometrically coupled continuous-wave optical parametric oscillators
abstract: We report a novel architecture for cw OPOs based on antiresonant ring interferometric cavity coupling, providing two pairs of signal/idler waves with independent tuning and arbitrarily close wavelength separation.

articleTitle: Speckle free laser imaging
abstract: Speckle and related coherent artifacts limit the use of lasers for imaging, despite their potential advantages (i.e. brightness). We demonstrate speckle-free laser imaging using a random laser designed to produce spatially incoherent emission.

articleTitle: Mode-locked 2 μm thulium-doped fiber laser with graphene oxide saturable absorber
abstract: Few-layer graphene oxide depositing on broadband reflective mirror as a novel saturable absorber for mode-locking of a thulium-doped fiber laser at 2007 nm, which generated 0.56 nJ single pulse energy at 3.17 MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Self-aligned silicon fins in metallic slits as a platform for planar tunable nanoscale resonant photodetectors
abstract: We demonstrate self-aligned fabrication of etched silicon fins in metallic slits and show that this structure supports both dielectric and plasmonic resonances and photodetection that can be tuned by varying the width of the fin.

articleTitle: On-chip multimode photonics
abstract: We design and demonstrate an integrated multimode waveguide platform with minimal inter-modal crosstalk on silicon. This platform is designed using computer-optimized transformation optics and fabricated using high aspect ratio grayscale lithography with ultra high precision.

articleTitle: Large-scale laser spectral compression using a true dispersion-increasing fiber
abstract: We demonstrate large-scale true adiabatic soliton spectral compression using a dispersion-increasing fiber in the 1.57 μm wavelength region. A record-high spectral compression ratio of 28.4 is experimentally achieved.

articleTitle: Towards giga-pixel microscopy
abstract: We report a wide field-of-view (FOV) microscopy imaging system that is capable to capture a 10 mm * 7.5 mm FOV image with submicron resolution, resulting in 0.54 giga-pixels across the entire image.

articleTitle: Directionality and integration of nanoscale plasmon lasers
abstract: We demonstrated the first directionally emitting deep sub-wavelength plasmon laser and circuit. The plasmon laser circuit naturally integrates photonic and electronic functionality allowing both efficient electrical modulation and wavelength multiplexing.

articleTitle: Phase-matched microstrip waveguides for generation and coherent detection of broadband terahertz radiation
abstract: We describe novel waveguide devices allowing for single-mode propagation of optical pump and probe beams and broadband THz radiation. We demonstrate generation and coherently detection of broadband THz radiation with <;10 mW average optical power.

articleTitle: Double crystal, dual synchronously pumped femtosecond optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator based on two PPLN crystals pumped by Ti:sapphire laser with dual synchronization for intracavity signal amplification across the tuning range 1420-1580 nm.

articleTitle: Optical wavelength shifting using resonant non-linearities in THz quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Phase-matched difference frequency mixing between a resonant bandgap near-infrared beam and a THz wave is demonstrated within a quantum cascade laser using second order non-linearities. Conversion efficiencies up to 0.16% are shown.

articleTitle: Tracking charge carriers through space and time in single silicon core-shell nanowires
abstract: We map space-and-time-dependent carrier dynamics in single silicon nanowires firstly, using ultrafast optical microscopy. This enables us to directly measure acoustic phonon oscillations and carrier velocities in Si and Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> core-shell nanowires.

articleTitle: Waveguides for pulsed terahertz radiation
abstract: In this tutorial, we review basic ideas of waveguide physics, and discuss the state of the art in strategies for guiding broadband terahertz pulses. These include metallic, dielectric, and plasmonic waveguides.

articleTitle: Phase modelocking of a Terahertz quantum cascade laser
abstract: Modelocking of a Terahertz Quantum Cascade Laser is achieved using multimode injection seeding. Contrarily to standard methods that rely on gain modulation, a fixed phase relationship is here directly imprinted to the QCL modes.

articleTitle: 9.6-mm Diameter femtosecond laser microsurgery probe
abstract: We present a 9.6-mm fiber-coupled probe for femtosecond laser microsurgery and nonlinear imaging. Towards enabling clinical use, we successfully reduced the volume of our earlier 18-mm surgery probe by 5 times, while improving optical performance.

articleTitle: All-optical quantum switching
abstract: Summary form only given. I will present progress in ultrafast all-optical quantum switching. χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup>-based devices can route entangled single photons without disturbing their quantum state, whereas χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>-based devices can, in principle, lead to dissipation-free quantum-optical Fredkin gates.

articleTitle: Design of an integrated III-V semiconductor single-plasmon source
abstract: We propose a single-plasmon source integrated on a semiconductor III-V platform. Analytic and numerical calculations show that an ultra-small resonating cavity can boost the spontaneous decay rate by 20-fold and the source efficiency by 70%.

articleTitle: Tunable mid-infrared source based on difference frequency generation of a femtosecond Tm-fiber system in orientation patterned GaAs
abstract: We demonstrate a mid-infrared source tunable from 6.7–12.7 μm via difference frequency generation in orientation-patterned GaAs, with 1.3 mW average output power. The input pulses are generated from a femtosecond Tm-doped-fiber laser system.

articleTitle: A practical orbital angular momentum spectrometer using time mapping
abstract: We demonstrate a compact and practical orbital angular momentum spectrometer for arbitrary input states, based on an optical delay loop. Extinction ratios of 44-8.7 were measured, mainly limited by the available input states.

articleTitle: High-speed quantum key distribution using hyper-entangled photons
abstract: We discuss a quantum cryptography system using the timing and polarization degrees of freedom to produce a high bit rate for both technologically limited eavesdroppers and for any potential eavesdroppers.

articleTitle: Bandwidth reconfigurable radio-frequency photonic filters based on directly generated Gaussian-shaped comb
abstract: We demonstrate bandwidth reconfigurable radio-frequency photonic filters based on optical frequency combs. By changing the comb bandwidth with a manually tunable RF attenuator, the filter bandwidth can be increased by the maximum of 112%.

articleTitle: Sub-diffraction-limited spatial resolution in CARS microscopy by ground state depletion
abstract: Suppression of CARS signal generation is demonstrated via ground state depletion in a theoretical investigation. Using a donut-shaped control light field for population transfer results in sub-diffraction-limited spatial resolution CARS microscopy.

articleTitle: Optimizations for simultaneous detection of atmospheric N2O and CO with a quantum cascade laser
abstract: A QCL laser based open-path sensor for atmospheric N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O/CO achieves a sensitivity of 0.26 ppbv of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O and 0.24 ppbv of CO in 1 s. Optimizations including dual modulation amplitudes and inline reference cell have been performed with WMS.

articleTitle: Accelerating and diffractionless beams in optical lattices
abstract: We show that only in a unique class of z-dependent lattices a true accelerating and diffractionless beam (different from Airy) can exist. Such beams are also possible under nonlinear conditions as exact traveling lattice solitons.

articleTitle: Photochemical microreactors in photonic crystal fibers
abstract: Hollow-core photonic crystal fiber offers new possibilities for sensing and photochemistry applications. In this paper we review our recent achievements on liquid-phase photochemical microreactors using photonic crystal fibers and discuss our future prospects in this field.

articleTitle: Self-referencing multimode photonic microresonator
abstract: We have demonstrated strong multimode photonic microresonator and nanoparticle interactions by using an integrated micro disk resonator from through port of the laser coupling bus waveguide. Here we report that a self referencing mechanism can be achieved by simultaneous excitation of both fundamental and 2nd order micro disk optical resonance modes. The strong photonic microresonator and nanoparticle interactions have variety of applications for optical switches, waveguides and detection. The self-referencing characteristics of the two optical resonance modes have potential to achieve photonic functions independent of external perturbation, such as temperature change.

articleTitle: Second order nonlinear optics with surface plasmon polaritons gap waveguides
abstract: Surface plasmon polariton gap waveguides are shown to provide both confinement and phasematching in the three wave nonlinear optical interactions opening exiting possibilities for efficient on chip frequency conversion and parametric generation.

articleTitle: Metamaterial thermal antenna using the Wolf effect
abstract: We propose a metamaterial device capable of highly directional thermal radiation using the Wolf effect. Our structure provides high emissivity in a narrow band and is tunable over a broad range of frequencies.

articleTitle: Fabrication of high-Q microresonators using femtosecond laser micromachining
abstract: We report a novel technique to fabricate microdisk resonators using femtosecond laser micromachining. The resonators had suppressed higher order modes with a measured Q-factor as high as 7.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>.

articleTitle: Low-repetition-rate fiber femtosecond laser oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a ring type, mode-locked all-normal-dispersion ytterbium-doped fiber laser which have 9.8 MHz repetition rate through the combination of saturable absorber mirror and nonlinear polarization evolution (NPE) phenomena.

articleTitle: Near-IR to Mid-IR multimode waveguides in rare-earth doped YAG by ultrafast laser inscription
abstract: We report near-infrared to mid-infrared (1.55 to 3.39 μm) multimode waveguiding in deep buried channel waveguides fabricated inside rare-earth ion doped ceramic YAG. Waveguiding is achieved by direct laser writing a tubular cladding region.

articleTitle: Transmission enhancement with the array of faced folded metallic rods embedded in a metallic slit
abstract: We propose that the array of plasmonic faced folded rods (FFR) enhances transmission of light in a narrow metallic slit. The FFR unit can play the role of light concentrator at the visible regime. Diffracted light from a sub-wavelength metallic slit can be transmitted into a far-field region and enhance light intensity when the array of FFRs is placed inside the metallic slit. Additional transmission enhancement from the FFR structure can be obtained from the localized couplings between FFR and its adjacent FFRs. Numerical approach using a rigorous coupled-wave analysis technique is adopted, and the functionality is shown by the use of optical microscopy which provides far-field intensity images emanating from the array of FFRs embedded in a metallic slit.

articleTitle: Optimal quantum control for conditional rotation of exciton qubits in semiconductor quantum dots
abstract: Pulse-shaping protocols are developed for a controlled-rotation gate in an InAs quantum dot with electronic structure calculated using k · p theory. The shaped pulses show a dramatic improvement in fidelity over transform-limited pulses.

articleTitle: Milli-joule level 2μm vortex pulses from an optical vortex pumped optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We demonstrated high energy 2 μm optical vortex pulse production from an optical vortex pumped hemispherical optical parametric oscillator. Maximum 2 μm optical vortex pulse energy of 2.1 mJ was achieved.

articleTitle: Deterministic aperiodic photonic structures based on woodpiles
abstract: By modulating the thickness of rods in a photonic woodpile according to deterministic aperiodic sequences we study the transition from a perfectly ordered photonic crystal to a disordered structure using transmission and reflection spectra.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Layers

articleTitle: Octave-wide characterization of highly nonlinear fiber dispersion
abstract: We demonstrate wide-band technique to characterize the dispersion properties of highly nonlinear fiber with record accuracy. The new method is based on processing of spectral fringes generated by the balanced interferometer transfer function when excited by parametric super-continuum source.

articleTitle: Single quantum dot locked to atomic transition
abstract: We tune and lock the exciton emission energy of a single quantum dot to an atomic transition. The locking precision of few micro-eV can allow for single charge sensing, spectral diffusion counteraction, and energy stabilization schemes.

articleTitle: Complementary apodized grating waveguides for tunable photonic delay lines
abstract: A novel class of tunable integrated photonic delay lines that compromises between loss and size is proposed. The devices comprise cascaded apodized grating waveguides with complementary (positively and negatively modulated) refractive index profiles.

articleTitle: Ultrafast metal-insulator transition in VO2 driven by electron injection
abstract: A novel all-optical method of triggering phase-transition in prototypical vanadium dioxide using the “hot-electron” effect is demonstrated. Structural and electronic switching times are retrieved by nondegenerate pump-probe transmission spectroscopy on the hybrid metallic/phase-changing nanomaterial.

articleTitle: Characterization of the RIN-to-phase-noise conversion in the mode-locked fiber lasers
abstract: A method to characterize the noise conversion from the relative intensity noise to the phase noise in the mode-locked fiber lasers is proposed. The method is based on pump modulation and external modulation techniques.

articleTitle: High throughput microscopy with a microlens array
abstract: We demonstrate large field-of-view (FOV) (30 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) fluorescence microscopy with submicron resolution using a refractive microlens array. The large area of the array decreases image acquisition time over FOVs by avoiding long-range mechanical scanning.

articleTitle: Attosecond lighthouses from plasma mirrors
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time experimentally a universal method - attosecond lighthouse effect - for producing temporally synchronized and spatially isolated attosecond light pulses, applied to a few-cycle laser-driven.

articleTitle: Wavelength scaling of hollow-core fiber compressor design parameters
abstract: We study supercontinuum generation using numerical simulations of the nonlinear propagation along hollow-core fibers at different pump wavelengths ranging from 400 nm to 2 μm. A general hollow fiber compressor design strategy is presented.

articleTitle: Fiber drawn 2D polymeric photonic crystal THz filters
abstract: In this paper, we report on different polymeric 2D photonic crystal filters for THz frequencies which are fabricated by a standard fiber drawing technique. The bandstop filters were simulated and designed by the generalized multipole technique (GMT). The frequency and angle dependent transmission characteristics of the photonic crystal structures were characterized in a pulsed terahertz (THz) time domain spectrometer.

articleTitle: Terahertz quantum cascade lasers based on phonon scattering assisted injection and extraction
abstract: A novel terahertz quantum cascade laser, based on consecutive phonon-photon-phonon emissions, is proposed. The design procedure used a density matrix based figure-of-merit and a generic algorithm approach; the fabricated device lased up to 138 K.

articleTitle: Quantum coherence controls the charge separation in a prototypical artificial light harvesting system
abstract: Ultrafast spectroscopy and quantum-dynamics simulations of an artificial supramolecular light-harvesting system give strong evidence that the quantum-correlated wavelike motion of electrons and nuclei governs the ultrafast electronic charge transfer.

articleTitle: Theory of ultrashort laser-matter interactions
abstract: High-energy laser pulses of subpicosecond duration irradiating metals or dielectrics are primarily absorbed by electrons within the solid. We study microscopic processes determining absorption, redistribution of the energy and its transfer to the crystal lattice. In particular, we model nonequilibrium electron distributions and discuss differences of materials' reaction due to the ultrashort timescales as compared to a near-equilibrium situation, which can usually be assumed on longer timescales.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a bright 50 Hz repetition rate table-top soft x-ray laser driven by a diode-pumped laser
abstract: We report the highest repetition rate table-top soft x-ray laser, 50Hz. Microjoule-level picosecond laser pulses were produced at λ=18.9nm by amplification in a molybdenum plasma generated by a 1 J diode-pumped chirped-pulse-amplification Yb-YAG laser.

articleTitle: Picosecond N-photon autocorrelator based on superconducting nanodetectors
abstract: We present a novel approach to an ultrafast N-photon autocorrelator with single-photon sensitivity based on superconducting nanodetectors. The hotspot relaxation time which determines the autocorrelator's temporal resolution was measured to be ~20 ps.

articleTitle: Nearly 3–6μm spectral comb derived from Tm mode-locked laser using GaAs-based degenerate OPO
abstract: We use a degenerate OPO pumped by an ultrafast 2050-nm Tm-fiber laser to generate a broadband mid-infrared comb. A GaAs gain element and dispersion management access an ~octave-wide output spectrum extending from 3.1 to 5.9μm.

articleTitle: Laser induced macroscopic vortices in a gas
abstract: Laser induced unidirectional molecular rotation is shown to give rise to macroscopic flow and rotational vortices which last orders of magnitude longer than the collision time or the laser pulse duration.

articleTitle: 3-D integration of silicon nitride on silicon-on-insulator platform
abstract: We propose a new material platform using vertical integration of silicon nitride on silicon-on-insulator for optimizing device performances in silicon photonics. Preliminary results including silicon nitride growth, high-Q resonator fabrication, and vertical integration are presented.

articleTitle: Feedback-controlled laser fabrication of micromirrors
abstract: Micromirror templates of uniform size were created on silica chips and fibers by a feedback-controlled laser ablation process. The templates were coated with a high reflectivity dielectric coating and assembled into high-finesse microcavities.

articleTitle: Logarithmically diverging two-photon spectrum: Anomalous scale symmetry breaking in two dimensions
abstract: For small area beams, the two-photon spectra of atoms diffusing in hot buffer gas approaches a universal, logarithmically-diverging shape, connected to anomalous scale symmetry breaking of a two-dimensional Hamiltonian.

articleTitle: A Quantum Cascade laser spectrometer for measurement of water vapor isotopes in the urban environment
abstract: A 7.12 μm Quantum Cascade laser-based water vapor isotope spectrometer for the real time measurement of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> and δ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O in the urban environment was developed with a detection limit for δ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O of 0.42 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub>.

articleTitle: Efficient UV emitters for sensing and disinfection
abstract: Deep UV LED structures with UV transparent design, highly reflective p-electrodes and die encapsulation exhibited peak external quantum efficiencies up to 5%. Modeling indicates further increases in efficiency through reduced defect-related nonradiative recombination.

articleTitle: Mid-IR self-compression to few-cycles in bulk material
abstract: We report on the self-compression of 10-cycle mid-IR optical pulses to ~5 cycle duration at 3.1 μm center wavelength with up to 3 μJ energy in Yttrium Aluminum garnet (YAG).

articleTitle: Transfer of topological charges in an electromagnetically induced transparency solid
abstract: Transfer of topological charges associated with optical vortices was experimentally demonstrated in a Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal through light pulse storage and retrieval technique based on electromagnetically induced transparency effect.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanogap-enhanced Raman scattering using a resonant nanodome array
abstract: We investigate the optical properties and surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) of plasmonic nanodome array substrates that are demonstrated to provide a reproducible SERS enhancement factor of 1.18×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> for detection of a urinary metabolite used to monitor kidney function.

articleTitle: Directed optical half-adder based on microring-resonator-based optical switches
abstract: We fabricate a directed optical logic circuit on silicon-on-insulator platform which can implement the addition of two bits. For proof of concept, a thermo-optic switch effect is employed with an operation speed of 10kbps.

articleTitle: Mode locked fiber lasers, past, present and future
abstract: We review the development of industrial mode locked fiber lasers and discuss novel fiber laser designs inspired by the concept of frequency combs and their impact in ultrafast optics and precision spectroscopy.

articleTitle: 10-fs pulse delivery through a fiber
abstract: Delivery of few-cycle pulses at 800 nm through a specially designed hollow-core fiber with less than 50% loss is reported. The fiber supports a >;200 nm bandwidth and features negative easy-to-compensate waveguide dispersion.

articleTitle: The evidence of phase memory in induced coherence without induced emission
abstract: Two signal beams emitted from two simultaneously pumped parametric down converters show first order interference if the two idler beams were aligned. Due to the effect of phase memory it is found that the first order interference of the signal beams can be controlled by the phase delay between the pump beams.

articleTitle: Coherent injection of microcavities polariton through two photon excitation
abstract: We present a technique based on a two-photon absorption process. We coherently inject polaritons in planar or pillar microcavities, being in resonance and with a well defined in plane wavevector (k) and show polariton laser.

articleTitle: Optofluidic silicon-polymer integrated waveguides
abstract: In this paper the design and the optical characterization of hybrid ARROW waveguide with a top layer of polydimethysiloxane (PDMS) is presented. The structure has been simulated and the results compared with the experimental one.

articleTitle: Ultralow 192 Hz RF linewidth optoelectronic oscillator based on the optical feedback of mode-locked laser diodes
abstract: We present an ultralow RF linewidth (192 Hz) and subpicosecond phase noise (260 fs) using a passively mode-locked quantum-well laser with feedback via a dual optical fiber loop.

articleTitle: Transition edge sensors with low timing jitter at 1550 nm
abstract: Transition edge sensors have demonstrated near unity detection efficiency of single photons and photon number resolving ability over a wide wavelength range (≈ 700-1600 nm). They are also known to be slow, with timing jitter values in the ≈ 100 ns range, and the best current values in the ≈ 20ns range. We report measured jitter times below 5ns for a tungsten TES. This is particularly relevant for experiments clocked from an 80MHz Ti:Sa laser.

articleTitle: Sensitivity enhancement of fiber-laser-based stimulated Raman scattering microscopy by intensity noise suppressor
abstract: Fiber laser pulses are split and combined with a delay to suppress the intensity noise by 23 dB, which is only 4-dB higher than the shot noise limit. Fiber-based stimulated Raman imaging is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of a 650 nm–2000 nm laser frequency comb based on an erbium fiber laser
abstract: We present an Er:fiber based laser frequency comb spanning 650 nm-2000 nm that employs amplification in Yb:fiber followed by continuum generation. Comb coherence is verified with f-2f interferometry and comparison to frequency stabilized lasers.

articleTitle: Measurement of the system-environment coupling and its relation to dynamical decoupling
abstract: We present a direct measurement of the bath coupling spectrum in an ensemble of trapped ultracold atoms, by applying a spectrally narrow-band control field. From the inferred spectrum, we predict the performance of some dynamical decoupling sequences.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of the mid-infrared pseudogap in stripe-phase La1.75Sr0.25NiO4
abstract: We present the first ultrafast mid-infrared study of charge and spin-ordered nickelates. A multi-component dynamics is observed, evidencing the femtosecond decay and formation of the low-energy pseudogap in the optical conductivity.

articleTitle: 533W peak power Yb:YAG composite waveguide laser
abstract: We demonstrated a Yb:YAG composite planar waveguide laser. Low-order mode waveguide is realized by refractive index difference between YAG and Yb:YAG. The peak power of 533-W was obtained at the Q-CW pumping power of 1506-W.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase double stabilization with eight attosecond residual timing jitter
abstract: We present a novel setup for carrier-envelope phase stabilization combining a feedback loop with a feed-forward type stabilization technique to push the residual timing down to 8 attoseconds, setting a new record in stabilization performance.

articleTitle: EC tuning of broadband QCL active region designs around 3.3 μm and 8 μm
abstract: Broadband-Quantum-Cascade-Lasers in the 3.3 μm and the 8 μm regions were tuned over 277 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and 445 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> respectively using a grating-tuned external cavity set-up. The junction-up mounted devices were HR and AR coated and operated in pulsed mode. Another device of the 8 μm design was operated in cw and yielded a tuning range of 247 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> without AR coating.

articleTitle: Classical analog of electromagnetically induced absorption in plasmonics
abstract: We present the classical analog of electromagnetically induced absorption which is achieved by tuning the coupling phase between a bright and a dark plasmonic resonance in the intermediate regime and thus obtaining constructive interference.

articleTitle: Investigation of linewidth of comb modes in MZM-based flat comb generator with optical feedback loop
abstract: We report on linewidth characteristics of comb signals generated by a Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator with an optical feedback loop. The linewidth of comb modes were narrower than that of the original laser.

articleTitle: Ultrafast thin disk lasers for intralaser extreme nonlinear optics
abstract: We demonstrate a sub-100-fs modelocked thin disk laser (TDL) and detect for the first time the carrier envelope offset (CEO) of a TDL, two key enabling milestones for future intracavity nonlinear experiments.

articleTitle: Broadband stopband filter for terahertz wave based on multi-layer metamaterial microstructure
abstract: We show that a multi-layer microstructure consisting of stacked rectangular ring resonators exhibit characteristics of broadband stopband filters having a bandwidth of 1.1 THz and a quality factor of 1.6.

articleTitle: Gallium Nitride distributed Bragg Reflector cavity for integrated photonics applications
abstract: A deep etched 1D Distributed Bragg Reflector cavity in GaN-AlN-Sapphire has been analytically modeled and simulated using 2D FDTD. A structure fabricated using a hybrid Electron Beam-Focused Ion Beam method was assessed using microphotoluminescence.

articleTitle: Novel approach in algae biofuel production using advanced photonics
abstract: Utilization of evanescent fields for photosynthetic bacteria to produce biofuel can lead to thousandfold decrease in the volume of photobioreactors. We demonstrate the growth of bacteria enabled by the evanescent excitation using planar waveguides.

articleTitle: Single ion trapped in the focal spot of a deep parabolic mirror
abstract: We report on trapping of single Ytterbium ions in the focal spot of a deep parabolic mirror providing a setup for efficient free space photon atom coupling. Additionally issues regarding imaging, ion localization and fluorescence collection are discussed.

articleTitle: Microscopic theory of quantum interference-based generation and decay of current in graphene
abstract: Microscopic calculations on carrier dynamics in graphene are applied to study the optically induced generation of a current density and its decay via Coulomb- and phonon-induced scattering channels.

articleTitle: Delayed fluorescence by reverse intersystem crossing and application to organic light-emitting diodes
abstract: Organic donor and acceptor interfaces give rise to a small energy gap between the singlet and triplet exciton levels (ΔE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ST</sub>) of generated exciplexes. We demonstrate that the small ΔE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ST</sub> can lead to efficient electroluminescence.

articleTitle: Intracavity self-generated 2π pulses and coherent population trapping in a mode-locked laser
abstract: 2π pulse self-induced transparency in rubidium is reported for the first time inside a mode-locked laser cavity. Simultaneous occurrence of a dark line repetition rate resonance is observed in the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb vapor cell.

articleTitle: Simultaneous detection of different substances by multiplexed excitation of ensembles of fluorescent bacteria
abstract: A scheme for simultaneous selective detection of the fluorescent signals emitted by a whole-cell biosensor array using one photomultiplier is presented. Experimental proof of concept is demonstrated in a four channel system.

articleTitle: Polymer-embedded arrays of vertical silicon nanowires as color filters
abstract: We demonstrate color filters comprising silicon nanowire arrays embedded in polymer. Each array's transmission spectrum contains one or more dips, whose positions can be tuned across the visible wavelength range by choice of nanowire radius.

articleTitle: How can modulational instability generate solitons?
abstract: Modulational instability converts cw light in a fiber into a train of pulses. We obtain its scattering eigenvalue spectrum and show that the pulses are not solitons. Raman shift can convert them to solitons, though.

articleTitle: Nonlinear and quantum optics in Mesoscopic photonic lattices
abstract: We describe nonlinear and quantum interactions of photons in chip-scale nanostructures and photonic crystals, including slow-light four-wave-mixing, femtosecond solitons, cavity optomechanics, quantum electrodynamics and information processing.

articleTitle: Observation of Bloch-like oscillations in Glauber-Fock oscillator lattices
abstract: We report the first observation of classical Bloch-like oscillations and revivals of light in a new class of dynamic optical systems-the so-called Glauber-Fock oscillator lattices.

articleTitle: Broadband polarization-insensitive wavelength conversion based on non-degenerate four-wave mixing in a silicon nanowire
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate broadband polarization-insensitive one-to-two wavelength conversion of a 10-Gb/s DPSK data signal based on non-degenerate four-wave mixing in a silicon nanowire with bit-error rate measurements.

articleTitle: Observation of a photon echo in GaMnAs
abstract: Four-wave mixing experiments on GaMnAs reveal a strong decrease in the interband dephasing time with the incorporation of Mn. The nonlinear response is characterized by a photon echo, despite the strong influence of disorder.

articleTitle: Efficient Mid-IR lasing in gas-filled hollow waveguides
abstract: Mid-IR lasers operating at 3–3.2 μm and 4.3–4.4 μm with efficiencies near 20% have been demonstrated from <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and HCN-filled low-loss (< 5 dB/m) kagome-structure HC-PCF and from CO-filled silver coated capillaries.

articleTitle: Correlating one-photon, two-photon and excited state spectroscopy of CdSe quantum dots
abstract: We present two-photon absorption and excited-state absorption spectra of quantum dots of various sizes. From the linear and transient spectra we determine transition dipole moments between the states and compare them with the two-photon cross sections.

articleTitle: Diodes for resonantly pumped CW and pulsed Er:YAG lasers
